## assets/business-challenge.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/**
 * @typedef {object} Refs
 * @property {HTMLElement[]} [items]
 * @property {HTMLElement[]} [reveals]
 * @extends Component<Refs>
 */
class BusinessChallenge extends Component {
  /** @type {AbortController | undefined} */
  #controller;
  /** @type {IntersectionObserver | undefined} */
  #observer;
  #motion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#cleanup();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  #initialize() {
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    this.#motion.addEventListener('change', this.#initializeReveal, { signal });
    this.#initializeReveal();
  }

  #initializeReveal = () => {
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
    const targets = [...(this.refs.reveals || []), ...(this.refs.items || [])].filter((item) => item.hasAttribute('data-reveal'));
    if (this.dataset.animate !== 'true' || this.#motion.matches || window.Shopify?.designMode || !targets.length) {
      this.classList.remove('reveal-ready');
      return;
    }
    this.#observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
        if (entry.target instanceof HTMLElement) entry.target.dataset.state = 'in';
        this.#observer?.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.1 });
    const visible = targets.map((target) => {
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < innerHeight;
    });
    for (const [index, target] of targets.entries()) {
      target.style.setProperty('--reveal-index', String(index));
      if (target.dataset.state !== 'in') target.dataset.state = visible[index] ? 'in' : 'before';
      if (target.dataset.state !== 'in') this.#observer.observe(target);
    }
    this.classList.add('reveal-ready');
  };

  #cleanup() {
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
    this.classList.remove('reveal-ready');
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('business-challenge-component')) {
  customElements.define('business-challenge-component', BusinessChallenge);
}
````

## assets/delivery-process.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/** One-time entrance animation for the delivery timeline. */
class DeliveryProcess extends Component {
  #controller;
  #observer;
  #motion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
  }

  #initialize() {
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    if (window.Shopify?.designMode) {
      this.addEventListener('shopify:block:select', (event) => {
        event.target.closest('.delivery-process__step')?.classList.add('is-revealed');
      }, { signal });
    }
    this.#motion.addEventListener('change', this.#reveal, { signal });
    this.#reveal();
  }

  #reveal = () => {
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
    if (this.#motion.matches || window.Shopify?.designMode) return;
    this.#observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
        entry.target.classList.add('is-revealed');
        this.#observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    this.querySelectorAll('.delivery-process__intro, .delivery-process__step').forEach((element) => {
      this.#observer.observe(element);
    });
  };

  #cleanup() {
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('delivery-process')) {
  customElements.define('delivery-process', DeliveryProcess);
}
````

## assets/footer-diagnosis.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/** Native contact form enhancement; validation/submission still work without JS. */
class FooterDiagnosis extends Component {
  #controller;
  #form;
  #website;
  #submitting = false;

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#cleanup();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  #initialize() {
    this.#form = this.querySelector('form');
    if (!this.#form) return;
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    this.#website = this.#form.querySelector('[data-footer-diagnosis-website]');
    this.#form.addEventListener('submit', this.#submit, { signal });
    this.#website?.addEventListener('blur', this.#normalize, { signal });
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', this.#reset, { signal });
    this.#reset();
  }

  #normalize = () => {
    if (!(this.#website instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const value = this.#website.value.trim();
    if (value && !/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(value)) {
      this.#website.value = `https://${value.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`;
    }
  };

  #submit = (event) => {
    if (this.#submitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    this.#normalize();
    if (!this.#form.checkValidity()) return;
    const signal = this.#controller.signal;
    // Other handlers may cancel native submission. No timers outlive the component.
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      if (signal.aborted || event.defaultPrevented) return;
      this.#submitting = true;
      this.#form.querySelector('[type="submit"]')?.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    });
  };

  #reset = () => {
    this.#submitting = false;
    this.#form?.querySelector('[type="submit"]')?.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
  };

  #cleanup() {
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#reset();
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('footer-diagnosis')) {
  customElements.define('footer-diagnosis', FooterDiagnosis);
}
````

## assets/growth-hero.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/**
 * Enhances native Hero background videos with scoped playback controls.
 * @typedef {object} Refs
 * @property {HTMLElement} media
 * @property {HTMLButtonElement} [toggle]
 * @property {HTMLElement} [icon]
 * @extends Component<Refs>
 */
class GrowthHero extends Component {
  requiredRefs = ['media'];
  /** @type {HTMLVideoElement[]} */
  #videos = [];
  /** @type {AbortController | undefined} */
  #controller;
  /** @type {IntersectionObserver | undefined} */
  #observer;
  #motion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  #viewport = matchMedia('(max-width: 749px)');
  #visible = false;
  #userPaused = false;
  #userStarted = false;
  #revision = 0;

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#cleanup();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  #initialize() {
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    this.#videos = [...this.refs.media.querySelectorAll('video')];
    for (const video of this.#videos) {
      video.controls = false;
      video.muted = true;
      video.autoplay = false;
      video.addEventListener('playing', () => {
        video.setAttribute('data-playing', '');
        this.#updateControl();
      }, { signal });
      video.addEventListener('pause', this.#updateControl, { signal });
      video.addEventListener('error', () => {
        video.removeAttribute('data-playing');
        this.#updateControl();
      }, { signal });
    }
    this.setAttribute('data-enhanced', '');
    this.#motion.addEventListener('change', () => {
      this.#userStarted = false;
      this.#sync();
    }, { signal });
    this.#viewport.addEventListener('change', this.#sync, { signal });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.#sync, { signal });
    this.#observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      this.#visible = entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting);
      this.#sync();
    });
    this.#observer.observe(this);
    this.#updateControl();
  }

  /** Public declarative click handler. @param {MouseEvent} event */
  togglePlayback(event) {
    if (!(event.currentTarget instanceof Element) && !(event.target instanceof Element)) return;
    const playing = this.#videos.some((video) => !video.paused);
    this.#userPaused = playing;
    this.#userStarted = !playing;
    this.#sync();
  }

  #sync = async () => {
    const revision = ++this.#revision;
    const shouldPlay = this.#visible && !document.hidden && !this.#userPaused && (!this.#motion.matches || this.#userStarted);
    const visible = this.#videos.map((video) => video.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0);
    for (const [index, video] of this.#videos.entries()) {
      if (!shouldPlay || !visible[index] || video.error) {
        video.pause();
        continue;
      }
      try {
        await video.play();
        if (revision !== this.#revision || !this.isConnected) {
          if (!this.isConnected || !this.#visible || document.hidden || this.#userPaused) video.pause();
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        // Autoplay denial retains the poster and offers explicit user playback.
        video.removeAttribute('data-playing');
      }
    }
    if (revision === this.#revision) this.#updateControl();
  };

  #updateControl = () => {
    const button = this.refs.toggle;
    if (!button) return;
    const active = this.#videos.filter((video) => video.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && !video.error);
    const playing = active.some((video) => !video.paused);
    button.hidden = active.length === 0;
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', (playing ? button.dataset.pauseLabel : button.dataset.playLabel) || '');
    if (this.refs.icon) this.refs.icon.textContent = playing ? 'Ⅱ' : '▶';
  };

  #cleanup() {
    ++this.#revision;
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
    for (const video of this.#videos) {
      video.pause();
      video.controls = true;
      video.removeAttribute('data-playing');
    }
    this.#videos = [];
    this.#visible = false;
    this.removeAttribute('data-enhanced');
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('growth-hero-component')) {
  customElements.define('growth-hero-component', GrowthHero);
}
````

## assets/scroll-reveal.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/** Shared one-shot reveal. Native connection/removal also covers editor reloads. */
class ScrollReveal extends Component {
  #observer;
  #controller;
  #motion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#cleanup();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  #initialize() {
    if (!this.hasAttribute('data-reveal-scope')) return;
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    this.#motion.addEventListener('change', this.#reveal, { signal });
    if (window.Shopify?.designMode) {
      // Keep block selection immediate; editor handlers never run on storefronts.
      this.addEventListener('shopify:block:select', this.#show, { signal });
      this.addEventListener('shopify:block:deselect', this.#show, { signal });
    }
    this.#reveal();
  }

  #show = () => {
    this.#observer?.disconnect();
    this.classList.remove('reveal-ready');
  };

  #reveal = () => {
    this.#show();
    const targets = [...this.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]')];
    if (this.#motion.matches || !targets.length || window.Shopify?.designMode) return;
    const timeline = this.hasAttribute('data-reveal-timeline');
    // Batch layout reads before dataset/style writes, including multi-card lists.
    const visible = targets.map((target) => {
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < window.innerHeight;
    });
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
        if (timeline) {
          for (const target of targets) target.dataset.state = 'in';
          observer.disconnect();
          break;
        }
        entry.target.dataset.state = 'in';
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { rootMargin: '-12% 0px 0px 0px', threshold: 0 });
    this.#observer = observer;
    targets.forEach((target, index) => {
      target.style.setProperty('--reveal-index', String(index));
      if (target.dataset.state !== 'in') target.dataset.state = !timeline && visible[index] ? 'in' : 'before';
      if (!timeline && target.dataset.state !== 'in') observer.observe(target);
    });
    if (timeline && targets.some((target) => target.dataset.state !== 'in')) observer.observe(this);
    this.classList.add('reveal-ready');
  };

  #cleanup() {
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#show();
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('scroll-reveal-component')) {
  customElements.define('scroll-reveal-component', ScrollReveal);
}
````

## assets/services-globe.js

````javascript
import { Component } from '@theme/component';

/** Viewport-gated decorative globe; static fallback needs no WebGL. */
class ServicesGlobe extends Component {
  requiredRefs = ['canvas', 'host', 'fallback'];
  #globe;
  #controller;
  #intersection;
  #resize;
  #motion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  #visible = false;
  #pending = false;
  #frame = 0;
  #resizeFrame = 0;
  #lastTime = 0;
  #phi = 0.8;

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  updatedCallback() {
    super.updatedCallback();
    this.#cleanup();
    this.#initialize();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#cleanup();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  #initialize() {
    this.#controller = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#controller;
    this.#motion.addEventListener('change', this.#sync, { signal });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.#sync, { signal });
    this.refs.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', this.#contextLost, { signal });
    this.#intersection = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      this.#visible = entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting);
      this.#sync();
    });
    this.#intersection.observe(this);
    this.#resize = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (this.#resizeFrame) return;
      this.#resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        this.#resizeFrame = 0;
        const size = this.refs.host.clientWidth;
        if (size > 0) this.#globe?.update({ width: size, height: size });
      });
    });
    this.#resize.observe(this.refs.host);
  }

  #sync = () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#frame);
    this.#frame = 0;
    this.#lastTime = 0;
    if (this.#motion.matches) {
      this.#releaseGlobe();
      return;
    }
    if (!this.#visible || document.hidden) return;
    if (!this.#globe) {
      void this.#create();
      return;
    }
    if (this.dataset.rotate === 'true' && !this.#motion.matches) {
      this.#frame = requestAnimationFrame(this.#animate);
    }
  };

  async #create() {
    if (this.#pending) return;
    const controller = this.#controller;
    this.#pending = true;
    try {
      const { default: createGlobe } = await import('./cobe.js');
      if (controller?.signal.aborted || !this.isConnected || !this.#visible || document.hidden || this.#motion.matches) return;
      const { canvas, host } = this.refs;
      const context = { alpha: true, antialias: true, depth: false, stencil: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: this.dataset.rotate !== 'true' || this.#motion.matches };
      const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl2', context) || canvas.getContext('webgl', context);
      if (!gl) return;
      const size = host.clientWidth;
      if (size <= 0) return;
      this.#globe = createGlobe(canvas, {
        width: size,
        height: size,
        devicePixelRatio: Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5),
        phi: this.#phi,
        theta: 0.35,
        dark: 0,
        diffuse: 0.9,
        mapSamples: 40000,
        mapBrightness: 1.25,
        mapBaseBrightness: 0,
        baseColor: [1, 1, 1],
        markerColor: [0, 0.16, 1],
        glowColor: [1, 1, 1],
        scale: 1.12,
        markers: [],
        context,
      });
      if (gl.isContextLost() || gl.getError() !== gl.NO_ERROR) {
        this.#globe.destroy();
        this.#globe = undefined;
        return;
      }
      this.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
      this.#sync();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[services-globe] Static globe retained:', error);
    } finally {
      if (this.#controller === controller) this.#pending = false;
    }
  }

  /** @param {number} time */
  #animate = (time) => {
    if (this.#lastTime) this.#phi += Math.min(time - this.#lastTime, 100) * 0.00006;
    this.#lastTime = time;
    this.#globe?.update({ phi: this.#phi });
    this.#frame = requestAnimationFrame(this.#animate);
  };

  /** @param {Event} event */
  #contextLost = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    this.#cleanup();
  };

  #cleanup() {
    this.#controller?.abort();
    this.#intersection?.disconnect();
    this.#resize?.disconnect();
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#frame);
    this.#frame = 0;
    this.#lastTime = 0;
    this.#visible = false;
    this.#pending = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#resizeFrame);
    this.#resizeFrame = 0;
    this.#releaseGlobe();
  }

  #releaseGlobe() {
    this.#globe?.destroy();
    this.#globe = undefined;
    // COBE v2 adds an anchor wrapper. Restore the original tree before a reconnect.
    const { canvas, host } = this.refs;
    if (canvas && host && canvas.parentElement !== host && host.contains(canvas)) {
      const wrapper = canvas.parentElement;
      host.append(canvas);
      wrapper?.remove();
    }
    this.removeAttribute('data-ready');
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('services-globe-component')) {
  customElements.define('services-globe-component', ServicesGlobe);
}
````

## blocks/_brand-logo.liquid

````liquid


{% liquid
  assign block_settings = block.settings
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
  endif
  assign has_logo = false
  if block_settings.image
    assign has_logo = true
  endif
  assign alt = block_settings.alt | default: block_settings.image.alt | default: shop.name
%}

{% if has_logo or request.design_mode %}
  {% capture logo_image %}
    {%- if has_logo -%}
      {{
        block_settings.image
        | image_url: width: 600
        | image_tag:
          width: block_settings.image.width,
          height: block_settings.image.height,
          widths: '120, 180, 240, 360, 480, 600',
          sizes: '(min-width: 750px) 180px, 120px',
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          class: 'brand-logo__image',
          alt: alt
      }}
    {%- else -%}
      {{ 'detailed-apparel-1' | placeholder_svg_tag: 'brand-logo__placeholder' }}
    {%- endif -%}
  {% endcapture %}

  {% if block_settings.link != blank %}
    <a
      href="{{ block_settings.link }}"
      class="brand-logo brand-logo--linked"
      {{ block.shopify_attributes }}
    >
      {{ logo_image }}
    </a>
  {% else %}
    <div class="brand-logo" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
      {{ logo_image }}
    </div>
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}

{% stylesheet %}
  .brand-logo {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: var(--brand-logo-height, 40px);
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .brand-logo--linked {
    transition: opacity var(--animation-speed) ease;
  }

  .brand-logo__image,
  .brand-logo__placeholder {
    height: 100%;
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) {
    .brand-logo--linked:hover {
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "t:names.logo",
  "tag": null,
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image",
      "label": "t:settings.image"
    },
    {
      "type": "url",
      "id": "link",
      "label": "t:settings.link"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "alt",
      "label": "t:settings.alt_text"
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:names.logo",
      "category": "t:categories.basic"
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

## blocks/_faq-row.liquid

````liquid
{% liquid
  assign block_settings = block.settings
%}

{%- capture faq_row_details -%}
  <details
    class="faq-row"
    data-reveal
    {% if block_settings.open_by_default %}
      open
    {% endif %}
    {{ block.shopify_attributes }}
  >
    <summary class="faq-row__summary">
      <span class="faq-row__toggle svg-wrapper icon-plus" aria-hidden="true">
        {{- 'icon-plus.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}
      </span>
      <span class="faq-row__question">{{ block_settings.question }}</span>
    </summary>

    <div class="details-content faq-row__answer">
      {{ block_settings.answer }}
    </div>
  </details>
{%- endcapture -%}

{% render 'accordion-custom-component',
  children: faq_row_details,
  close_with_escape: true,
  open_by_default_on_desktop: block_settings.open_by_default,
  open_by_default_on_mobile: block_settings.open_by_default
%}

{% stylesheet %}
  .faq-row {
    padding: 30px 20px;
    background-color: var(--faq-row-background, #e5e6ff);
    border-radius: var(--faq-row-radius, 16px);
  }

  .faq-row__summary {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: center;
    padding-block: 0;
    padding-inline: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 23px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: var(--faq-question-color, #3f4eff);
  }

  .faq-row__summary:focus-visible {
    outline: var(--focus-outline-width) solid currentcolor;
    outline-offset: 4px;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  .faq-row__summary .faq-row__toggle {
    display: grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: center;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    margin-inline-start: 0;
    color: var(--faq-icon-color, #3f4eff);
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .faq-row__toggle svg {
    display: block;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }

  .faq-row__question {
    min-width: 0;
    color: var(--faq-question-color, #3f4eff);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .faq-row__answer {
    padding-block: 14px 32px;
    padding-inline-start: calc(32px + 16px);
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 28px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--faq-answer-color, #595959);
  }

  .faq-row__answer > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .faq-row__answer > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .faq-row {
      padding: 20px 16px;
    }

    .faq-row__summary {
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .faq-row__summary .faq-row__toggle {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
    }

    .faq-row__toggle svg {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
    }

    .faq-row__answer {
      padding-block: 12px 24px;
      padding-inline-start: calc(28px + 12px);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 24px;
    }
  }
  .faq-row::details-content, .faq-row .details-content { transition: opacity var(--animation-speed-slow) var(--animation-easing); }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .faq-row::details-content, .faq-row .details-content { transition: none; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "t:names.accordion_row",
  "tag": null,
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "question",
      "label": "t:settings.title",
      "default": "What is MarTech, and how can it support global growth?"
    },
    {
      "type": "richtext",
      "id": "answer",
      "label": "t:settings.description"
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "open_by_default",
      "label": "t:settings.open_by_default",
      "default": false
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:names.accordion_row",
      "category": "t:categories.layout",
      "settings": {
        "question": "What is MarTech, and how can it support global growth?"
      }
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

## blocks/_result-card.liquid

````liquid
{% liquid
  assign block_settings = block.settings
  assign image_alt = block_settings.image.alt | default: block_settings.tag | default: ''
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
  endif
%}

<article class="result-card" data-reveal {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
  <div class="result-card__media">
    {%- if block_settings.image != blank -%}
      {{
        block_settings.image
        | image_url: width: 846
        | image_tag:
          widths: '423, 600, 846',
          sizes: '(min-width: 750px) 423px, 85vw',
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          class: 'result-card__image',
          alt: image_alt
      }}
    {%- endif -%}
  </div>

  <div class="result-card__body">
    {%- if block_settings.tag != blank -%}
      <span class="result-card__tag">{{ block_settings.tag }}</span>
    {%- endif -%}

    {%- if block_settings.description != blank -%}
      <div class="result-card__description">{{ block_settings.description }}</div>
    {%- endif -%}

    <div class="result-card__metrics">
      <div class="result-card__metric">
        <span class="result-card__metric-value">{{ block_settings.metric_1_value }}</span>
        <span class="result-card__metric-label">{{ block_settings.metric_1_label }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="result-card__metric">
        <span class="result-card__metric-value">{{ block_settings.metric_2_value }}</span>
        <span class="result-card__metric-label">{{ block_settings.metric_2_label }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</article>

{% stylesheet %}
  .result-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: var(--work-card-width, 497px);
    height: var(--work-card-height, 653px);
    padding-block: var(--work-card-padding-block-start, 46px) var(--work-card-padding-block-end, 46px);
    padding-inline: var(--work-card-padding-inline-start, 37px) var(--work-card-padding-inline-end, 37px);
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: var(--work-card-background, #ffffff);
    border-radius: var(--work-card-radius, 16px);
  }

  .result-card__media {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 423 / 264;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-image: linear-gradient(103.31deg, #e5edfd 0.33%, #f8e5f2 99.67%);
    border-radius: var(--work-card-media-radius, 12px);
  }

  .result-card__image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .result-card__body {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  .result-card__tag {
    align-self: flex-start;
    margin-block-start: 26px;
    padding: 6.5px 25px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--work-tag-color, #9a66f8);
    background-color: var(--work-tag-background, #eaebf8);
    border: 1px dashed var(--work-tag-border, #e8c1ee);
    border-radius: 5px;
  }

  .result-card__description {
    display: -webkit-box;
    margin-block-start: 26px;
    overflow: hidden;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 31px;
    color: var(--work-description-color, #000000);
  }

  .result-card__metrics {
    display: flex;
    gap: 146px;
    margin-block-start: auto;
    padding-block-start: 20px;
  }

  .result-card__metric {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 13px;
  }

  .result-card__metric-value {
    font-family: var(--font-body--family);
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 25.2px;
    letter-spacing: -0.99px;
    color: var(--work-metric-color, #783edf);
  }

  .result-card__metric-label {
    font-family: Inter;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: var(--work-metric-label-color, #000000);
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .result-card {
      width: min(85vw, var(--work-card-width, 497px));
      height: auto;
      padding: 24px 20px;
    }

    .result-card__tag {
      margin-block-start: 20px;
    }

    .result-card__description {
      margin-block-start: 14px;
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 26px;
    }

    .result-card__metrics {
      gap: 20px;
      padding-block-start: 16px;
    }

    .result-card__metric-value {
      font-size: 40px;
      line-height: 24px;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "t:names.result_card",
  "tag": null,
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image",
      "label": "t:settings.image"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "tag",
      "label": "t:settings.label",
      "default": "Client logo"
    },
    {
      "type": "richtext",
      "id": "description",
      "label": "t:settings.description"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.metric_1"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "metric_1_value",
      "label": "t:settings.text",
      "default": "00%"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "metric_1_label",
      "label": "t:settings.label",
      "default": "Metric to be filled"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.metric_2"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "metric_2_value",
      "label": "t:settings.text",
      "default": "0.0x"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "metric_2_label",
      "label": "t:settings.label",
      "default": "Metric to be filled"
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:names.result_card",
      "category": "t:categories.layout",
      "settings": {
        "tag": "Client logo",
        "metric_1_value": "00%",
        "metric_1_label": "Metric to be filled",
        "metric_2_value": "0.0x",
        "metric_2_label": "Metric to be filled"
      }
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

## blocks/_value-prop.liquid

````liquid
{% liquid
  assign block_settings = block.settings
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
  endif
  assign icon = block_settings.icon
%}

<div class="value-prop" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
  <div
    class="value-prop__badge"
    style="--value-prop-ring: {{ block_settings.circle_color | default: '#4183ff' }};"
  >
    <span
      class="value-prop__icon value-prop__icon--{{ icon }}"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {%- if block_settings.image != blank -%}
        {{
          block_settings.image
          | image_url: width: 120
          | image_tag:
            widths: '40, 80, 120',
            sizes: '40px',
            class: 'value-prop__image',
            loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
            alt: ''
        }}
      {%- else -%}
        {%- case icon -%}
          {%- when 'team' -%}
            {{ 'icon-why-team.svg' | inline_asset_content }}
          {%- when 'global' -%}
            {{ 'icon-why-global.svg' | inline_asset_content }}
          {%- when 'layers' -%}
            {{ 'icon-why-layers.svg' | inline_asset_content }}
          {%- when 'bars' -%}
            {{ 'icon-why-bars.svg' | inline_asset_content }}
        {%- endcase -%}
      {%- endif -%}
    </span>
  </div>

  {%- if block_settings.title != blank -%}
    <p class="value-prop__title">{{ block_settings.title }}</p>
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- if block_settings.description != blank -%}
    <div class="value-prop__description">{{ block_settings.description }}</div>
  {%- endif -%}
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .value-prop {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .value-prop__badge {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 98px;
    height: 98px;
    margin-block-end: 6px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid var(--value-prop-ring, #4183ff);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .value-prop__icon {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    max-width: 40px;
    max-height: 40px;
  }

  .value-prop__icon svg,
  .value-prop__image {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    max-width: 40px;
    max-height: 40px;
  }

  .value-prop__icon--bars {
    transform: rotate(90deg);
  }

  .value-prop__title {
    min-height: 2.8em;
    margin: 0 0 6px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .value-prop__description {
    font-family:Montserrat;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 2;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .value-prop__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .value-prop__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "t:names.value_prop",
  "tag": null,
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "icon",
      "label": "t:settings.icon",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "team",
          "label": "t:options.icon_team"
        },
        {
          "value": "global",
          "label": "t:options.icon_global"
        },
        {
          "value": "layers",
          "label": "t:options.icon_layers"
        },
        {
          "value": "bars",
          "label": "t:options.icon_bars"
        }
      ],
      "default": "team"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image",
      "label": "t:settings.image"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "circle_color",
      "label": "t:settings.color",
      "default": "#4183FF"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "title",
      "label": "t:settings.title",
      "default": "Integrated, End-to-End Expertise"
    },
    {
      "type": "richtext",
      "id": "description",
      "label": "t:settings.description"
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:names.value_prop",
      "category": "t:categories.storytelling"
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

````jsonc
  "html_defaults": {
    "share_information_about_your": "<p>Partagez des informations sur votre marque avec vos clients. Décrivez un produit, faites des annonces ou accueillez les clients dans votre boutique.</p>",
    "bestseller_h2": "<h2>Meilleures ventes</h2>",
    "bestseller_h3": "<h3>Meilleures ventes</h3>",
    "bestseller": "<p>Meilleure vente</p>",
    "build_better": "<p>Nous croyons en l’amélioration continue</p>",
    "contact_us": "<h2>Contactez-nous</h2>",
    "discover_bestsellers": "<p>Découvrez les meilleures ventes qui ont conquis le cœur de nos clients grâce à leur mélange parfait de fonctionnalité et de style.</p>",
    "everythings_starts_with_why": "<p>Tout ce que nous faisons commence par un « pourquoi »</p>",
    "explore_latest_products": "<p>Découvrez nos derniers produits.</p>",
    "faq": "<h2>Foire aux questions</h2>",
    "first_to_know": "<p>Soyez les premiers informés des nouvelles collections et des offres spéciales. </p>",
    "free_returns": "<p>Retours gratuits sous 30 jours</p>",
    "free_shipping_over": "<p>Livraison gratuite pour les commandes de plus de 50 $</p>",
    "goal_for_every_customer": "<p>Notre objectif est que chaque client soit entièrement satisfait de son achat. Si ce n’est pas le cas, faites-le-nous savoir et nous ferons de notre mieux pour trouver une solution avec vous.</p>",
    "home_to_shirts": "<p>Accueil → Chemises</p>",
    "intentional_design": "<h2>Conception intentionnelle</h2>",
    "introducing_p": "<p><em>Présentation</em></p>",
    "latest_products": "<p>Découvrez nos derniers produits, conçus spécialement pour la saison. Achetez vos favoris avant qu’ils ne disparaissent !</p>",
    "made_local_and_global": "<p>Nos produits sont fabriqués localement et dans le monde entier. Nous sélectionnons soigneusement nos partenaires de fabrication pour garantir que nos produits sont de haute qualité et d’un juste rapport qualité-prix.</p>",
    "made_with_care_h2": "<h2>Fabriqué avec soin</h2>",
    "made_with_care_extended": "<p>Fabriquée avec soin et inconditionnellement appréciée par nos clients, cette meilleure vente emblématique dépasse toutes les attentes.</p>",
    "made_with_care": "<p>Fabriqué avec soin et inconditionnellement apprécié par nos clients.</p>",
    "make_things_better_extended": "<p>Nous fabriquons des articles plus performants et plus durables. Nos produits résolvent de vrais problèmes avec un design épuré et des matériaux honnêtes.</p>",
    "make_things_better": "<p>Nous fabriquons des articles plus performants et plus durables.</p>",
    "may_also_like": "<h2>Vous aimerez peut-être aussi</h2>",
    "new_arrivals_h1": "<h1>Nouveautés</h1>",
    "new_arrivals_h2": "<h2>Nouveautés</h2>",
    "new_arrivals_h3": "<h3>Nouveautés</h3>",
    "product_launch": "<p>Découvrez les coulisses de notre dernier lancement de produit.</p>",
    "product_story": "<p>Au cœur de chaque produit se trouve une histoire unique, animée par notre passion pour la qualité et l’innovation. Chaque article améliore votre quotidien et suscite de la joie.</p>",
    "real_people": "<p>De vraies personnes qui fabriquent d’excellents produits</p>",
    "related_product": "<h2>Produits connexes</h2>",
    "return_policy": "<h2>Quelle est la politique de retour ?</h2>",
    "reviews": "<p>★★★★★ 368 avis</p>",
    "shipping_based_on_location": "<p>L’expédition est calculée en fonction de votre emplacement et des articles de votre commande. Vous connaîtrez toujours le prix de l’expédition avant d’effectuer votre achat.</p>",
    "shop_by_collection": "<h3>Magasiner par collection</h3>",
    "signature_products": "<h2>Notre produit phare</h2>",
    "styled_with": "<h3>Porté avec</h3>",
    "subscribe": "<h2>Abonnez-vous à nos e-mails</h2>",
    "team_with_goal": "<h2>Une équipe avec un objectif</h2>",
    "unable_to_accept_returns": "<p>Nous ne pouvons pas accepter les retours sur certains articles. Ceux-ci seront clairement indiqués avant l’achat.</p>",
    "work_quickly_to_ship": "<p>Nous nous efforcerons d’expédier votre commande le plus rapidement possible. Une fois votre commande expédiée, vous recevrez un e-mail contenant des informations supplémentaires. Les délais de livraison varient en fonction de votre emplacement.</p>",
    "join_our_email_list": "<h2>Inscrivez-vous à notre liste de diffusion</h2>",
    "get_exclusive_deals_and_early_access_to_new_products": "<p>Recevez des offres exclusives et un accès anticipé aux nouveaux produits.</p>",

    "authentic_materials": "<p>Matériaux authentiques, sans compromis </p>",
    "bold_style_recognizable": "<p>Un style audacieux reconnaissable partout</p>",
````

````jsonc
    "discover_bestsellers": "<p>גלה את רבי-המכר שכבשו את לב לקוחותינו עם השילוב המושלם שלהם בין פונקציונליות וסגנון.</p>",

    "first_to_know": "<p>היה הראשון לדעת על קולקציות חדשות ומבצעים מיוחדים. </p>",
    "free_returns": "<p>החזרות חינם תוך 30 ימים</p>",
    "free_shipping_over": "<p>משלוח חינם בקנייה מעל $50</p>",
    "goal_for_every_customer": "<p>המטרה שלנו היא שכל לקוח יהיה מרוצה לחלוטין מהרכישה שלו. אם זה לא המקרה, יידע אותנו ונעשה כמיטב יכולתנו לפעול מולך כדי לתקן זאת.</p>",
    "home_to_shirts": "<p>דף הבית ← חולצות</p>",
    "intentional_design": "<h2>עיצוב מכוון</h2>",
    "introducing_p": "<p><em>מציגים</em></p>",
    "latest_products": "<p>מציגים את המוצרים החדשים שלנו, שנוצרו במיוחד לעונה. קנה את המועדפים עליך לפני שייגמרו!</p>",
    "made_local_and_global": "<p>המוצרים שלנו מיוצרים גם באופן מקומי וגם ברחבי העולם. אנו בוחרים בקפידה את שותפי הייצור שלנו כדי להבטיח שהמוצרים שלנו יהיו באיכות גבוהה ובתמורה הוגנת.</p>",
    "made_to_last": "<p>נועד להחזיק מעמד </p>",
    "made_with_care_h2": "<h2>נוצר בתשומת לב</h2>",
    "made_with_care_extended": "<p>נוצר בתשומת לב ואהוב ללא תנאי על ידי לקוחותינו, רב-מכר הדגל הזה עולה על כל הציפיות.</p>",
    "made_with_care": "<p>נוצר בתשומת לב ואהוב ללא תנאי על ידי לקוחותינו.</p>",
    "make_things_better_extended": "<p>אנחנו מייצרים דברים שעובדים טוב יותר ומחזיקים מעמד זמן רב יותר. המוצרים שלנו פותרים בעיות אמיתיות עם עיצוב נקי וחומרים כנים.</p>",
    "make_things_better": "<p>אנחנו מייצרים דברים שעובדים טוב יותר ומחזיקים מעמד זמן רב יותר.</p>",

    "new_arrivals_h1": "<h1>מוצרים חדשים</h1>",
    "pieces_better_with_time": "<p>פריטים שרק משתפרים עם הזמן והשימוש </p>",
    "new_arrivals_h2": "<h2>מוצרים חדשים</h2>",
    "new_arrivals_h3": "<h3>מוצרים חדשים</h3>",
    "product_launch": "<p>הצץ אל מאחורי הקלעים של השקת המוצר האחרונה שלנו.</p>",
    "product_story": "<p>בלב כל מוצר מסתתר סיפור ייחודי, המונע מהתשוקה שלנו לאיכות וחדשנות. כל פריט מעשיר את חיי היומיום שלך ומעורר שמחה.</p>",
    "quality_you_can_feel": "<h2>איכות שאפשר להרגיש</h2>",
    "real_people": "<p>אנשים אמיתיים שמייצרים מוצרים מעולים</p>",
    "related_product": "<h2>מוצרים קשורים</h2>",
    "return_policy": "<h2>מהי מדיניות ההחזרות?</h2>",
    "reviews": "<p>★★★★★ 368 ביקורות</p>",
    "share_information_about_your": "<p>שתף מידע על המותג שלך עם הלקוחות שלך. תאר מוצר, פרסם הכרזות או קבל את פני הלקוחות בחנות שלך.</p>",
    "shipping_based_on_location": "<p>המשלוח מחושב על סמך המיקום שלך והפריטים בהזמנה שלך. תמיד תדע את מחיר המשלוח לפני הרכישה.</p>",

    "shop_collection": "<p>גלה את האוסף שנבחר בקפידה, הכולל מועדפים המשלבים סגנון ואיכות.</p>",
````

````jsonc
    "share_information_about_your": "<p>고객과 브랜드에 대한 정보를 공유하세요. 제품을 설명하거나, 공지 사항을 알리거나, 스토어를 방문하는 고객을 환영할 수 있습니다.</p>",

    "first_to_know": "<p>새로운 컬렉션과 특별 할인에 대한 소식을 가장 먼저 받아보세요. </p>",

    "goal_for_every_customer": "<p>모든 고객이 구매에 완전히 만족하는 것이 저희의 목표입니다. 그렇지 않은 경우 저희에게 알려주시면 문제를 해결하기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다.</p>",
    "home_to_shirts": "<p>홈 → 셔츠</p>",

    "introducing_p": "<p><em>소개합니다</em></p>",
    "latest_products": "<p>이번 시즌을 위해 특별히 제작된 최신 제품을 소개합니다. 품절되기 전에 마음에 드는 제품을 쇼핑하세요!</p>",
    "made_local_and_global": "<p>저희 제품은 국내 및 해외에서 제조됩니다. 저희는 제품의 높은 품질과 합리적인 가치를 보장하기 위해 제조 파트너를 신중하게 선택합니다.</p>",
    "made_with_care_h2": "<h2>정성을 담아 제작</h2>",
    "made_with_care_extended": "<p>정성을 다해 제작하고 고객의 무한한 사랑을 받는 이 시그니처 베스트셀러는 모든 기대를 뛰어넘습니다.</p>",
    "made_with_care": "<p>정성을 다해 제작하고 고객의 무한한 사랑을 받습니다.</p>",
    "make_things_better_extended": "<p>저희는 더 잘 작동하고 더 오래 지속되는 제품을 만듭니다. 저희 제품은 깔끔한 디자인과 정직한 소재로 실제 문제를 해결합니다.</p>",

    "product_story": "<p>모든 제품의 중심에는 품질과 혁신에 대한 열정으로 탄생한 고유한 스토리가 있습니다. 각 품목은 여러분의 일상을 향상시키고 즐거움을 선사합니다.</p>",
````

````jsonc
  "html_defaults": {
    "share_information_about_your": "<p>Markanızla ilgili bilgileri müşterilerinizle paylaşın. Bir ürünü açıklayın, duyurular yapın veya mağazanıza gelen müşterileri karşılayın.</p>",

    "contact_us": "<h2>Bize ulaşın</h2>",
    "discover_bestsellers": "<p>İşlevsellik ve stili mükemmel bir şekilde harmanlayarak müşterilerimizin kalbini fetheden çok satanları keşfedin.</p>",

    "goal_for_every_customer": "<p>Amacımız, her müşterinin satın alımından tamamen memnun kalmasıdır. Durum böyle değilse bize bildirin. Sorunu çözmek için elimizden geleni yaparız.</p>",
    "home_to_shirts": "<p>Ana Sayfa → Gömlekler</p>",

    "made_local_and_global": "<p>Ürünlerimiz hem yerel hem de küresel olarak üretilmektedir. Ürünlerimizin yüksek kaliteli ve uygun fiyatlı olmasını sağlamak için üretim ortaklarımızı özenle seçiyoruz.</p>",
    "made_with_care_h2": "<h2>Özenle üretildi</h2>",

    "made_with_care": "<p>Özenle üretildi ve müşterilerimiz tarafından koşulsuzca sevildi.</p>",
    "make_things_better_extended": "<p>Daha iyi çalışan ve daha uzun ömürlü ürünler üretiyoruz. Ürünlerimiz, sade tasarımları ve kaliteli malzemeleriyle gerçek sorunları çözüyor.</p>",
    "make_things_better": "<p>Daha iyi çalışan ve daha uzun ömürlü ürünler üretiyoruz.</p>",

    "product_launch": "<p>En son ürün lansmanımızın perde arkasına bir göz atın.</p>",
````

## sections/aidea-model.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  AIDEA marketing growth model. Original Figma layers surround editable labels.
  @example Add "AIDEA model" in the theme editor and customize the model copy.
{% endcomment %}

<div class="section-background aidea-model__background" style="--aidea-bg-from:{{ section.settings.background_from }};--aidea-bg-to:{{ section.settings.background_to }};"></div>
<div class="section section--full-width spacing-style aidea-model" style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section.settings %}">
  <div class="aidea-model__content">
    <img class="aidea-model__orbit" src="{{ 'aidea-329.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="1440" height="1335" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
    <div class="aidea-model__intro">
      {% if section.settings.heading != blank %}
        <h2 class="aidea-model__heading">{{ section.settings.heading | escape }}</h2>
      {% endif %}
      {% if section.settings.description != blank %}
        <p class="aidea-model__description">{{ section.settings.description | escape | newline_to_br }}</p>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="aidea-model__diagram">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-331.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="980" height="980" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:15.90278%;top:-8.36735%;width:68.05556%;height:100%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-332.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="580" height="117" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:29.8055%;top:-0.09178%;width:40.25014%;height:11.93878%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-335.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="405" height="325" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:35.87964%;top:29.717%;width:28.10184%;height:33.14015%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-345.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="200" height="200" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:19.02778%;top:11.12245%;width:13.88889%;height:20.40816%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-357.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="156" height="156" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:44.51389%;top:5.5102%;width:10.83333%;height:15.91837%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-358.png' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="58" height="57" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:47.84722%;top:8.67347%;width:4.02778%;height:5.81633%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-363.png' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="62" height="62" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:65%;top:48.97959%;width:4.30556%;height:6.32653%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-367.png' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="66" height="66" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:30.27778%;top:48.26531%;width:4.58333%;height:6.73469%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-333.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="311" height="521" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:20.69444%;top:31.38781%;width:21.5625%;height:53.12635%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-334.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="11" height="71" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:49.56019%;top:63.87755%;width:0.74073%;height:7.22788%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-340.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="63" height="39" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:31.92125%;top:27.61896%;width:4.34435%;height:3.97451%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-341.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="63" height="39" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:63.50694%;top:27.61896%;width:4.34436%;height:3.97451%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-355.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="312" height="522" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:57.5%;top:31.38779%;width:21.66667%;height:53.17198%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-345.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="200" height="200" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:42.98611%;top:72.2449%;width:13.88889%;height:20.40816%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-345.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="200" height="200" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:67.29167%;top:11.22449%;width:13.88889%;height:20.40816%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-357.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="156" height="156" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:61.875%;top:46.73469%;width:10.83333%;height:15.91837%;">
      <img class="aidea-model__asset" src="{{ 'aidea-357.svg' | asset_url }}" alt="" width="156" height="156" decoding="async" loading="lazy" style="left:27.15278%;top:46.73469%;width:10.83333%;height:15.91837%;">
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:49.93056%;top:34.18367%;width:24.30556%;font-size:1.66667cqw;line-height:1.5;">{{ section.settings.ai_label | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:49.96528%;top:39.38776%;width:12.5%;font-size:8.33333cqw;line-height:1.2;">{{ section.settings.ai | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:25.97222%;top:12.2449%;width:10.41667%;font-size:7.36111cqw;line-height:1.2075471698113207;">{{ section.settings.data_letter | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:26.07639%;top:23.26531%;width:12.15278%;font-size:1.31944cqw;line-height:1.2105263157894737;">{{ section.settings.data_label | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:74.27083%;top:12.2449%;width:10.41667%;font-size:7.36111cqw;line-height:1.2075471698113207;">{{ section.settings.experience_letter | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:74.20139%;top:23.26531%;width:11.80556%;font-size:1.31944cqw;line-height:1.2105263157894737;">{{ section.settings.experience_label | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:49.96528%;top:73.16327%;width:10.41667%;font-size:7.36111cqw;line-height:1.2075471698113207;">{{ section.settings.achievement_letter | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label" style="left:49.89583%;top:83.57143%;width:12.15278%;font-size:1.31944cqw;line-height:1.2105263157894737;">{{ section.settings.achievement_label | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label aidea-model__label--blue" style="left:49.96528%;top:14.69388%;width:9.72222%;font-size:1.04167cqw;line-height:2.24;">{{ section.settings.optimization | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label aidea-model__label--blue" style="left:67.25694%;top:55.20408%;width:9.72222%;font-size:1.04167cqw;line-height:1.24;">{{ section.settings.opportunities | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
      <div class="aidea-model__label aidea-model__label--blue" style="left:32.56944%;top:54.69388%;width:9.72222%;font-size:1.04167cqw;line-height:1.24;">{{ section.settings.customer_growth | escape | newline_to_br }}</div>
    </div>
    <ul class="aidea-model__mobile-labels">
      {% assign label_keys = 'ai_label,data_label,experience_label,achievement_label,optimization,customer_growth,opportunities' | split: ',' %}
      {% for key in label_keys limit: 7 %}
        {% if section.settings[key] != blank %}
          <li>{{ section.settings[key] | escape | newline_to_br }}</li>
        {% endif %}
      {% endfor %}
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .aidea-model__background {
    background: linear-gradient(122deg, var(--aidea-bg-from), var(--aidea-bg-to));
  }
  .aidea-model { overflow: clip; }
  .aidea-model__content {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1440px;
    margin-inline: auto;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .aidea-model__orbit {
    position: absolute;
    top: -84px;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .aidea-model__intro {
    position: relative;
    margin-inline: 5.833333%;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
  }
  .aidea-model__heading {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 4.02778vw, 58px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.22;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    color: #0b22b8;
    background: linear-gradient(117deg, #0b22b8 11%, #9621c4 89%);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }
  .aidea-model__description {
    max-width: 857px;
    margin-block: 40px 0;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 2.08333vw, 30px);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.23;
    color: #000;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .aidea-model__diagram {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 1440 / 980;
    width: 80%;
    margin-inline: auto;
    margin-block-start: 85px;
    container-type: inline-size;
    direction: ltr;
  }
  .aidea-model__asset { position: absolute; max-width: none; pointer-events: none; }
  .aidea-model__label {
    position: absolute;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-family: var(--font-accent--family);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .aidea-model__label--blue { color: #1362fa; }
  .aidea-model__mobile-labels { display: none; }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .aidea-model__description { margin-block-start: 24px; }
    .aidea-model__diagram { width: 116%; margin-inline: -8%; margin-block-start: 40px; }
    .aidea-model__mobile-labels {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 24px 6% 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body--family);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: #0b22b8;
    }
    .aidea-model__mobile-labels li { padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffffb3; }
    .aidea-model__mobile-labels li:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/blog-grid.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Product solutions grid.
  Renders a gradient headline above a grid of cards that are generated by
  looping products in a selected collection. Each card links to its product, and a
  footer button links to the collection.
  @example
  <!-- Add "Product solutions grid", then select a product collection -->
{% endcomment %}

<script
  src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}"
  type="module"
  fetchpriority="low"
></script>

{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
  assign product_collection = section_settings.collection
  assign product_limit = section_settings.product_limit
  assign view_all_href = section_settings.view_all_link | default: product_collection.url
%}



<div class="section-background product-solutions-grid__background"></div>

<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--page-width product-solutions-grid spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --solutions-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_from }};
    --solutions-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_to }};
    --solutions-columns: {{ section_settings.columns }};
    --solutions-gap: {{ section_settings.gap }}px;
    --solutions-heading-gap: {{ section_settings.heading_gap }}px;
    --product-solution-card-background: {{ section_settings.card_background }};
    --product-solution-card-border: {{ section_settings.card_border }};
    --product-solution-card-radius: {{ section_settings.card_radius }}px;
    --product-solution-card-padding-block-start: {{ section_settings.card_padding_block_start }}px;
    --product-solution-card-padding-block-end: {{ section_settings.card_padding_block_end }}px;
    --product-solution-card-padding-inline-start: {{ section_settings.card_padding_inline_start }}px;
    --product-solution-card-padding-inline-end: {{ section_settings.card_padding_inline_end }}px;
    --solutions-heading-font-family: {{ section_settings.font }};
    --solutions-heading-font-size: {{ section_settings.font_size }};
    --solutions-heading-font-weight: {{ section_settings.weight }};
    --solutions-heading-line-height: {{ section_settings.line_height | default: '1' }};
    --text-wrap: {{ section_settings.wrap | default: 'balance' }};
  "
  data-reveal-scope
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if heading_text != blank %}
    {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
    <div
      class="
        product-solutions-grid__heading
        text-block
        text-block--full-width
        {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
      "
      style="
        {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
          --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
          --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
          --gradient-angle: 92.97deg;
          --gradient-start: 10.56%;
          --gradient-end: 89.44%;
        {% endif %}
      "
      data-reveal
    >
      {{ heading_text }}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {% if product_collection != blank and product_collection.products_count > 0 %}
    <div class="product-solutions-grid__grid">
      {%- for product in product_collection.products limit: product_limit -%}
        {%- liquid
          assign product_description = product.description
          if product_description != blank
            assign product_description = product_description | strip_html | truncatewords: 60
          endif
        -%}
        <a class="product-solution-card" href="{{ product.url }}" aria-label="{{ product.title | escape }}" data-reveal>
          <h3 class="product-solution-card__title">{{ product.title | escape }}</h3>

          {%- if product_description != blank -%}
            <div class="product-solution-card__excerpt">{{ product_description | escape }}</div>
          {%- endif -%}

          {%- if section_settings.read_more_label != blank -%}
            <span class="product-solution-card__more">{{ section_settings.read_more_label }}</span>
          {%- endif -%}
        </a>
      {%- endfor -%}
    </div>
  {% elsif request.design_mode %}
    <div class="product-solutions-grid__grid">
      {%- for i in (1..product_limit) -%}
        <div class="product-solution-card" data-reveal>
          <h3 class="product-solution-card__title">{{ 'content.select_product_solution' | t }}</h3>
          <div class="product-solution-card__excerpt">{{ 'content.read_more' | t }}</div>
        </div>
      {%- endfor -%}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {% if view_all_href != blank and section_settings.view_all_label != blank %}
    <div class="product-solutions-grid__footer">
      <a class="product-solutions-grid__view-all" href="{{ view_all_href }}">
        {{- section_settings.view_all_label -}}
      </a>
    </div>
  {% endif %}
</scroll-reveal-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .product-solutions-grid__background {
    background-image: radial-gradient(
      54.79% 79.25% at 48.72% 36.96%,
      var(--solutions-bg-from, #c5d9ff) 14.56%,
      var(--solutions-bg-to, #a9c4ff) 100%
    );
  }

  .product-solutions-grid__heading {
    /* Constrain the box so the text gradient spans the text rather than the
       full content width (which would shift the colours). */
    max-width: var(--max-width--display-narrow, 9.75em);
    font-family: var(--solutions-heading-font-family, var(--font-heading--family));
    font-size: var(--solutions-heading-font-size, 3.625rem);
    font-weight: var(--solutions-heading-font-weight, 600);
    line-height: var(--solutions-heading-line-height, 1);
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .product-solutions-grid__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--solutions-columns, 3), minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--solutions-gap, 32px);
    width: 100%;
    margin-block-start: var(--solutions-heading-gap, 40px);
  }

  .product-solution-card {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-block: var(--product-solution-card-padding-block-start, 24px) var(--product-solution-card-padding-block-end, 24px);
    padding-inline: var(--product-solution-card-padding-inline-start, 16px) var(--product-solution-card-padding-inline-end, 16px);
    color: #000000;
    text-decoration: none;
    background-color: var(--product-solution-card-background, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.58));
    border: 1px solid var(--product-solution-card-border, rgb(255 255 255 / 1));
    border-radius: var(--product-solution-card-radius, 13px);
    transition:
      transform 0.3s var(--ease-out-cubic),
      box-shadow 0.3s var(--ease-out-cubic);
  }

  .product-solution-card__title {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #000000;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .product-solution-card__excerpt {
    margin-block-start: 37px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #000000;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .product-solution-card__more {
    position: relative;
    align-self: flex-start;
    margin-block-start: auto;
    padding-block-start: 20px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #000000;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* Read More underline: drawn with a pseudo-element, left-to-right on hover. */
  .product-solution-card__more::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    bottom: -2px;
    height: 1px;
    background-color: currentcolor;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease-out-cubic);
  }

  .product-solutions-grid__footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    margin-block-start: 40px;
  }

  .product-solutions-grid__view-all {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 18px 41px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #000000;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.58);
    border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 1);
    border-radius: 12px;
    transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease-out-cubic);
  }

  @media (hover: hover) {
    .product-solution-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px 0 rgb(11 34 184 / 0.15);
    }

    .product-solution-card:hover .product-solution-card__more::after,
    .product-solution-card__more:hover::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }

    .product-solutions-grid__view-all:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .product-solution-card,
    .product-solutions-grid__view-all,
    .product-solution-card__more::after {
      transition: none;
    }

    .product-solution-card:hover,
    .product-solutions-grid__view-all:hover {
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .product-solutions-grid__grid {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-block-start: 24px;
    }

    .product-solutions-grid__heading {
      font-size: 2.25rem;
    }

    .product-solution-card__title {
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .product-solutions-grid__view-all {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      font-size: 18px;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/business-challenge.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Growth potential. Editable challenge list and an associated growth-potential diagram.
  DOM order stays introduction, figure, then challenges at every viewport size.
  @example
  <!-- Add Growth potential below the homepage Hero and edit its Challenge blocks. -->
{% endcomment %}
{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
  assign color_id = 'business-challenge-' | append: section.id
%}
{% render 'contrast-override', background_color: s.background_color, text_color: s.text_color, section_id: color_id %}
{% render 'text-block-styles' %}
{% if s.enable_animation %}{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}{% endif %}
{% if s.enable_animation %}<script src="{{ 'business-challenge.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>{% endif %}

<business-challenge-component
  class="business-challenge spacing-style color-custom-{{ color_id }}"
  data-animate="{{ s.enable_animation }}"
  style="
    {% render 'spacing-style', settings: s %}
    --challenge-font: {{ s.font }};
    --challenge-heading-size: {{ s.font_size }};
    --challenge-accent: {{ s.accent_color }};
    --challenge-description: {{ s.description_color }};
    --challenge-caption: {{ s.caption_color }};
    --challenge-center-color: {{ s.center_text_color }};
    --challenge-divider: {{ s.divider_color }};
    --gradient-from: {{ s.gradient_color_from }};
    --gradient-to: {{ s.gradient_color_to }};
    --gradient-angle: 112.81deg;
    --gradient-start: 11.742%;
    --gradient-end: 88.258%;
  "
>
  <div class="business-challenge__layout">
    <div class="business-challenge__intro" {% if s.enable_animation %}data-reveal ref="reveals[]"{% endif %}>
      {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="business-challenge__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
      {% if s.heading != blank %}<h2 class="business-challenge__heading text-block{% if s.gradient_text %} text-block--gradient{% endif %}">{{ s.heading | escape }}</h2>{% endif %}
    </div>
    <figure class="business-challenge__figure" {% if s.enable_animation %}data-reveal ref="reveals[]"{% endif %}>
      {% render 'challenge-diagram', center_text: s.center_text, center_tint: s.center_tint %}
      {% if s.caption != blank %}<figcaption class="business-challenge__caption">{{ s.caption | escape }}</figcaption>{% endif %}
    </figure>
    <div class="business-challenge__list">
      {% content_for 'blocks' %}
    </div>
  </div>
</business-challenge-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .business-challenge { display: block; container-type: inline-size; font-family: var(--challenge-font, var(--font-heading--family)); color: var(--color-foreground); }
  .business-challenge__layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 484px) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'figure intro' 'figure list'; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 60px 90px; inline-size: calc(100% - 48px); max-inline-size: 1316px; margin-inline: auto; align-items: start; }
  .business-challenge__intro { grid-area: intro; min-inline-size: 0; max-inline-size: 732px; }
  .business-challenge__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 15px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5833; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .business-challenge__heading { margin: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: min(var(--challenge-heading-size), 4.028cqw); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.0345; letter-spacing: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-wrap: pretty; color: var(--color-foreground); }
  .business-challenge__figure { grid-area: figure; min-inline-size: 0; inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 484px; margin: 82px 0 0; }
  .business-challenge__caption { max-inline-size: 436px; margin-block-start: 33px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 8px; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4737; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--challenge-caption); }
  .business-challenge__list { grid-area: list; min-inline-size: 0; max-inline-size: 704px; }
  .business-challenge.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { transform: translateY(16px); transition-duration: 0.4s; transition-delay: calc(var(--reveal-index, 0) * 60ms); }
  .business-challenge.reveal-ready .business-challenge__figure[data-reveal] { transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.97); }
  .business-challenge.reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='in'] { transform: none; }
  @media screen and (min-width: 750px) and (max-width: 1099px) { .business-challenge__layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 36%) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px 32px; } .business-challenge__heading { font-size: min(var(--challenge-heading-size), 2.625rem); line-height: 1.1; } .business-challenge__figure { margin-block-start: 70px; } }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .business-challenge__layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'intro' 'figure' 'list'; gap: 32px; }
    .business-challenge__eyebrow { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; margin-block-end: 12px; }
    .business-challenge__heading { font-size: min(var(--challenge-heading-size), 2rem); line-height: 1.125; }
    .business-challenge__figure { max-inline-size: 320px; margin: 0; justify-self: center; }
    .business-challenge__caption { margin-block-start: 24px; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .business-challenge.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } .business-challenge.reveal-ready .business-challenge__figure[data-reveal] { transform: none; } }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/cta-banner.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Callout banner.
  Renders a full-bleed gradient background with a rounded gradient panel holding
  a gradient heading on the left and a description plus call-to-action link on
  the right.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Callout banner" section and edit the copy and link -->
{% endcomment %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
%}



<div
  class="section-background cta-banner__background"
  style="
    --cta-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --cta-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
    --cta-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
  "
></div>

<div
  class="section section--page-width cta-banner spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}"
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  <div
    class="cta-banner__panel spacing-style"
    style="
      --padding-block-start: {{ section_settings.panel_padding_block_start }}px;
      --padding-block-end: {{ section_settings.panel_padding_block_end }}px;
      --padding-inline-start: {{ section_settings.panel_padding_inline_start }}px;
      --padding-inline-end: {{ section_settings.panel_padding_inline_end }}px;

    --cta-panel-radius: {{ section_settings.panel_radius }}px;
    --cta-panel-from: {{ section_settings.panel_gradient_from }};
    --cta-panel-to: {{ section_settings.panel_gradient_to }};
    --cta-panel-angle: {{ section_settings.panel_gradient_angle }}deg;
    --cta-button-background: {{ section_settings.button_background }};
    --cta-button-color: {{ section_settings.button_text_color }};
    --cta-button-radius: {{ section_settings.button_radius }}px;
    --cta-description-color: {{ section_settings.description_color }};
  "
  >
    {% if heading_text != blank %}
      {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
      <div
        class="
          cta-banner__heading
          text-block
          text-block--full-width
          custom-typography
          custom-font-size
          {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
        "
        style="
          {% render 'typography-style', settings: section_settings, type: 'heading', preset: 'custom' %}
          {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
            --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
            --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
            --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
            --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
            --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
          {% endif %}
        "
      >
        {{ heading_text }}
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="cta-banner__aside">
      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="cta-banner__description">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.link != blank and section_settings.link_label != blank %}
        <a class="cta-banner__button" href="{{ section_settings.link }}">
          {{- section_settings.link_label -}}
          <span class="cta-banner__button-icon" aria-hidden="true">
            {{- 'icon-arrow.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}
          </span>
        </a>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .cta-banner__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--cta-bg-angle, 104deg),
      var(--cta-bg-from, #aac5ff) 2.81%,
      var(--cta-bg-to, #cbd5fd) 97.19%
    );
  }

  .cta-banner__panel {
    aspect-ratio: 1272 / 291;
    display: flex;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 100%;
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--cta-panel-angle, 92deg),
      var(--cta-panel-from, #6379ef) 0.42%,
      var(--cta-panel-to, #b62cf6) 99.58%
    );
    border-radius: var(--cta-panel-radius, 23px);
  }

  .cta-banner__heading {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .cta-banner__aside {
    display: flex;
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 28px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    max-width: 582px;
  }

  .cta-banner__description {
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 34px;
    color: var(--cta-description-color, #ffffff);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .cta-banner__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .cta-banner__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  .cta-banner__button {
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 16px 26px;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--cta-button-color, #6d28d9);
    background-color: var(--cta-button-background, #ffffff);
    border-radius: var(--cta-button-radius, 30px);
    transition:
      transform 0.25s var(--ease-out-cubic),
      box-shadow 0.25s var(--ease-out-cubic);
  }

  .cta-banner__button-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out-cubic);
  }

  .cta-banner__button-icon svg {
    display: block;
    width: 1em;
    height: 1em;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) {
    .cta-banner__button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 24px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);
    }

    .cta-banner__button:hover .cta-banner__button-icon {
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .cta-banner__button,
    .cta-banner__button-icon {
      transition: none;
    }

    .cta-banner__button:hover {
      transform: none;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .cta-banner__button:hover .cta-banner__button-icon {
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .cta-banner__panel {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .cta-banner__aside {
      max-width: none;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````
