## sections/delivery-process.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Delivery process: editable introduction and ordered delivery steps.
  Number circles and connecting lines are drawn with CSS; no image assets required.
  Add "Delivery process" in the theme editor; steps can be added or reordered.
{% endcomment %}
{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
%}
<div class="section-background delivery-process__background" style="--delivery-bg: {{ s.background }};"></div>
<delivery-process class="section section--full-width spacing-style delivery-process" style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: s %} --delivery-heading: {{ s.heading_gradient }}; --delivery-text: {{ s.text_color }}; --delivery-accent: {{ s.accent_color }}; --delivery-gap: {{ s.step_gap }}px;">
  <div class="delivery-process__inner">
    <div class="delivery-process__intro">
      {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="delivery-process__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
      {% if s.heading != blank %}<h2 class="delivery-process__heading">{{ s.heading | escape }}</h2>{% endif %}
      {% if s.description != blank %}<div class="delivery-process__description">{{ s.description }}</div>{% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if section.blocks.size > 0 %}
      <ol class="delivery-process__steps" role="list">
        {% for block in section.blocks limit: 50 %}
          <li class="delivery-process__step" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
            <div class="delivery-process__marker" aria-hidden="true">
              <span class="delivery-process__number">{% if forloop.index < 10 %}0{% endif %}{{ forloop.index }}</span>
              {% unless forloop.last %}
                <span class="delivery-process__connector"></span>
              {% endunless %}
            </div>
            <div class="delivery-process__copy">
              {% if block.settings.heading != blank %}<h3 class="delivery-process__step-heading">{{ block.settings.heading | escape }}</h3>{% endif %}
              {% if block.settings.description != blank %}<div class="delivery-process__step-description">{{ block.settings.description }}</div>{% endif %}
              {% if block.settings.deliverable != blank %}<p class="delivery-process__deliverable">{{ block.settings.deliverable | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
            </div>
          </li>
        {% endfor %}
      </ol>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</delivery-process>
<script src="{{ 'delivery-process.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>
{% stylesheet %}
  .delivery-process__background { background: var(--delivery-bg); }
  .delivery-process { display: grid; color: var(--delivery-text); font-family: var(--font-heading--family); }
  .delivery-process__inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 666fr) minmax(0, 555fr); gap: 31.5px; width: calc(100% - 124px); max-width: 1316px; margin-inline: auto; align-items: start; }
  .delivery-process__intro { padding-block-start: 161px; min-width: 0; }
  .delivery-process__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 38px; }
  .delivery-process__heading { margin: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: clamp(32px, 4.02778vw, 58px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.22; letter-spacing: normal; color: var(--delivery-accent); background: var(--delivery-heading); background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .delivery-process__description { max-width: 560.244px; margin-block-start: 11px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 38px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .delivery-process__steps { padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; }
  .delivery-process__step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 37px; position: relative; min-height: calc(107px + var(--delivery-gap)); }
  .delivery-process__step:last-child { min-height: 107px; }
  .delivery-process__marker { position: relative; padding-block-start: 22px; }
  .delivery-process__number { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 22px; height: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid var(--delivery-accent); border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 400; line-height: normal; color: var(--delivery-accent); }
  .delivery-process__connector { position: absolute; top: 86px; bottom: -22px; inset-inline-start: 31.5px; width: 1px; background: var(--delivery-accent); opacity: 0.6; }
  .delivery-process__copy { min-width: 0; padding-block-end: var(--delivery-gap); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .delivery-process__step:last-child .delivery-process__copy { padding-block-end: 0; }
  .delivery-process__step-heading { margin: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: normal; color: inherit; }
  .delivery-process__step-description { margin-block-start: 10px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; }
  .delivery-process__deliverable { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 17px; color: var(--delivery-accent); }
  .delivery-process__description > :first-child, .delivery-process__step-description > :first-child { margin-block-start: 0; }
  .delivery-process__description > :last-child, .delivery-process__step-description > :last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }
  @media screen and (max-width: 989px) {
    .delivery-process__inner { width: calc(100% - 64px); gap: 28px; }
    .delivery-process__intro { padding-block-start: 80px; }
    .delivery-process__description { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .delivery-process__step { column-gap: 20px; }
    .delivery-process__step-heading { font-size: 21px; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .delivery-process__inner { width: calc(100% - 40px); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px; }
    .delivery-process__intro { padding-block-start: 0; }
    .delivery-process__eyebrow { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin-block-end: 12px; }
    .delivery-process__heading { font-size: clamp(30px, 7.7vw, 46px); }
    .delivery-process__description { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; margin-block-start: 16px; }
    .delivery-process__step { column-gap: 20px; }
    .delivery-process__step-description { font-size: 15px; }
    .delivery-process__deliverable { line-height: 1.5; }
  }

  .delivery-process__copy { transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
  .delivery-process__step-heading { transition: opacity 240ms ease; }
  .delivery-process__intro.is-revealed,
  .delivery-process__step.is-revealed .delivery-process__copy { animation: delivery-process-enter 650ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; }
  @keyframes delivery-process-enter { from { opacity: 0.35; translate: 0 16px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } }
  @media screen and (min-width: 990px) {
    .delivery-process__intro { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--header-height, 0px) + 32px); margin-block-start: 161px; padding-block-start: 0; }
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .delivery-process__step:hover .delivery-process__copy { transform: translateX(6px); }
    [dir='rtl'] .delivery-process__step:hover .delivery-process__copy { transform: translateX(-6px); }
    .delivery-process__step:hover .delivery-process__step-heading { color: var(--delivery-accent); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .delivery-process__intro.is-revealed,
    .delivery-process__step.is-revealed .delivery-process__copy { animation: none; }
    .delivery-process__copy, .delivery-process__step-heading { transition: none; }
    .delivery-process__step:hover .delivery-process__copy { transform: none; }
    .delivery-process__intro { position: static; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/faq.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  FAQ.
  Renders a centered eyebrow, a gradient headline, and supporting copy above a
  list of merchant-managed accordion rows on a full-bleed gradient background.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "FAQ" section, then edit each question row block -->
{% endcomment %}

<script
  src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}"
  type="module"
  fetchpriority="low"
></script>

{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
%}



<div
  class="section-background faq__background"
  style="
    --faq-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
    --faq-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --faq-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
  "
></div>

<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--page-width faq spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --faq-heading-gap: {{ section_settings.heading_gap }}px;
    --faq-row-gap: {{ section_settings.row_gap }}px;
    --faq-row-background: {{ section_settings.row_background }};
    --faq-row-radius: {{ section_settings.row_radius }}px;
    --faq-question-color: {{ section_settings.question_color }};
    --faq-answer-color: {{ section_settings.answer_color }};
    --faq-icon-color: {{ section_settings.icon_color }};
    --faq-list-max-width: {{ section_settings.list_max_width }}px;
    --faq-heading-font-family: {{ section_settings.font }};
    --faq-heading-font-size: {{ section_settings.font_size }};
    --faq-heading-font-weight: {{ section_settings.weight }};
    --faq-heading-line-height: {{ section_settings.line_height | default: '1.3' }};
    --faq-heading-letter-spacing: -1.31px;
    --text-wrap: {{ section_settings.wrap | default: 'balance' }};
  "
  data-reveal-scope
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank or heading_text != blank or section_settings.description != blank %}
    <div class="faq__intro" data-reveal>
      {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank %}
        <p class="faq__eyebrow">{{ section_settings.eyebrow }}</p>
      {% endif %}

      {% if heading_text != blank %}
        {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
        <div
          class="
            faq__heading
            text-block
            text-block--full-width
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
          "
          style="
            --text-align: center;
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
              --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
              --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
              --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
              --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
              --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
            {% endif %}
          "
        >
          {{ heading_text }}
        </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="faq__description">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {%- capture faq_rows -%}
    {% content_for 'blocks' %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if faq_rows != blank %}
    <div class="faq__list">{{ faq_rows }}</div>
  {% endif %}
</scroll-reveal-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .faq__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--faq-bg-angle, 104deg),
      var(--faq-bg-from, #aac5ff) 2.81%,
      var(--faq-bg-to, #cbd5fd) 97.19%
    );
  }

  .faq__intro {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .faq__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #000000;
  }

  .faq__heading {
    font-family: var(--faq-heading-font-family, var(--font-heading--family));
    font-size: var(--faq-heading-font-size, 3.625rem);
    font-weight: var(--faq-heading-font-weight, 600);
    line-height: var(--faq-heading-line-height, 1.3);
    letter-spacing: var(--faq-heading-letter-spacing, -1.31px);
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .faq__description {
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #000000;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .faq__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .faq__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  .faq__list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--faq-row-gap, 8px);
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--faq-list-max-width, 780px);
    margin-inline: auto;
    margin-block-start: var(--faq-heading-gap, 32px);
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .faq__eyebrow {
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .faq__heading {
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .faq__description {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .faq__list {
      --faq-heading-gap: 24px;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/featured-client-story.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Featured Client Story. Editable case summary, metric blocks and responsive client media.
  Metric blocks remain static. An empty destination is previewed only in the editor.
  @example Add Featured Client Story, replace the copy and image, and configure the case link.
{% endcomment %}
{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
  assign color_id = 'client-story-' | append: section.id
  assign desktop_image = s.image | default: s.image_mobile
  assign mobile_image = s.image_mobile | default: desktop_image
  assign image_alt = s.image_alt | default: desktop_image.alt
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  assign image_priority = 'auto'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
    if section.index == 1
      assign image_priority = 'high'
    endif
  endif
%}
{% render 'custom-section-fonts', font: s.font %}
{% render 'contrast-override', text_color: s.text_color, section_id: color_id %}
{% if s.enable_reveal %}
  {% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}
  <script src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>
{% endif %}
<div class="client-story__background" style="background: {{ s.background | default: 'transparent' }};" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--full-width spacing-style client-story color-custom-{{ color_id }}"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: s %}
    --client-story-font: {{ s.font.family | escape }}, {{ s.font.fallback_families }};
    --client-story-panel: {{ s.panel_background | default: 'transparent' }};
    --client-story-gradient: {{ s.heading_gradient | default: s.text_color }};
    --client-story-accent: {{ s.accent_color }};
    --client-story-border: rgb({{ s.accent_color.rgb }} / 0.17);
    --client-story-media: {{ s.media_background }};
    --client-story-button-background: {{ s.button_background }};
    --client-story-button-color: {{ s.button_text_color }};
    --client-story-radius: {{ s.card_radius }}px;"
  {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal-scope{% endif %}
>
  <div class="client-story__card" {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal{% endif %}>
    <div class="client-story__copy">
      {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="client-story__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
      {% if s.heading != blank %}<h2 class="client-story__heading">{{ s.heading | escape | newline_to_br }}</h2>{% endif %}
      {% if s.description != blank %}<div class="client-story__description">{{ s.description }}</div>{% endif %}
      {% capture metrics %}{% content_for 'blocks' %}{% endcapture %}
      {% if metrics != blank %}<div class="client-story__metrics">{{ metrics }}</div>{% endif %}
      {% if s.link_label != blank %}
        {% if s.link != blank %}
          <a class="client-story__button" href="{{ s.link | escape }}">{{ s.link_label | escape }}<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
        {% elsif request.design_mode %}
          <span class="client-story__button client-story__button--preview">{{ s.link_label | escape }}<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="client-story__media">
      {% if desktop_image != blank %}
        <picture class="client-story__picture">
          {% if mobile_image != desktop_image %}
            <source media="(max-width: 749px)" srcset="{{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 375 }} 375w, {{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 750 }} 750w, {{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 1100 }} 1100w" sizes="calc(100vw - 40px)" width="{{ mobile_image.width }}" height="{{ mobile_image.height }}">
          {% endif %}
          {{ desktop_image | image_url: width: 2200 | image_tag: class: 'client-story__image', widths: '375,550,750,1100,1500,1800,2200', sizes: '(min-width: 1440px) 702px, (min-width: 990px) 49vw, (min-width: 750px) calc(100vw - 64px), calc(100vw - 40px)', loading: image_loading, fetchpriority: image_priority, decoding: 'async', alt: image_alt }}
        </picture>
      {% else %}
        {% render 'custom-client-story-placeholder' %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
</scroll-reveal-component>
{% stylesheet %}
  .client-story__background { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: var(--layer-section-background, -1); pointer-events: none; }
  .client-story { font-family: var(--client-story-font, var(--font-heading--family)); color: var(--color-foreground); }
  .client-story__card { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 636fr) minmax(0, 702fr); inline-size: calc(100% - 100px); max-inline-size: 1340px; min-block-size: 704px; margin-inline: auto; border: 1px solid var(--client-story-border); border-radius: var(--client-story-radius); background: var(--client-story-panel); overflow: clip; }
  .client-story__card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; inline-size: 26px; background: var(--client-story-accent); pointer-events: none; }
  .client-story__copy { min-inline-size: 0; padding: 40px 30px 20px 92px; }
  .client-story__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 38px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .client-story__heading { max-inline-size: 513px; margin: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 54px; letter-spacing: normal; background: var(--client-story-gradient); background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .client-story__description { max-inline-size: 513px; margin-block-start: 19px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 30px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .client-story__description > :first-child { margin-block-start: 0; }
  .client-story__description > :last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }
  .client-story__description a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
  .client-story__metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 193px)); gap: 15px 70px; max-inline-size: 456px; margin-block-start: 35px; margin-inline-start: -15px; }
  .client-story__button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; max-inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: 53.176px; margin-block-start: 41px; margin-inline-start: 3px; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 54px; background: var(--client-story-button-background); color: var(--client-story-button-color); font-family: inherit; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .client-story__button span { flex: none; }
  .client-story__button:focus-visible, .client-story__description a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--client-story-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
  .client-story__button--preview { cursor: default; }
  .client-story__media { position: relative; min-inline-size: 0; min-block-size: 702px; background: var(--client-story-media); }
  .client-story__picture { display: block; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
  .client-story__image { display: block; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }
  [dir='rtl'] .client-story__copy { padding-inline: 92px 30px; }
  @media screen and (min-width: 990px) and (max-width: 1439px) {
.client-story__card { inline-size: calc(100% - 64px); min-block-size: 0; }
  .client-story__card::before { inline-size: 18px; }
  .client-story__copy, [dir='rtl'] .client-story__copy { padding: 32px; padding-inline-start: 50px; }
  .client-story__eyebrow { font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; }
  .client-story__heading { font-size: clamp(30px, 3.0556vw, 44px); line-height: 1.227273; }
  .client-story__description { font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; }
  .client-story__metrics { gap: 15px 24px; margin-inline-start: 0; }
  .client-story__button { margin-inline-start: 0; font-size: 18px; }
  .client-story__media { min-block-size: 0; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 989px) {
.client-story__card { inline-size: calc(100% - 64px); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); min-block-size: 0; }
  .client-story__card::before { inline-size: 12px; }
  .client-story__copy, [dir='rtl'] .client-story__copy { padding: 36px; padding-inline-start: 48px; }
  .client-story__eyebrow { font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; }
  .client-story__heading { max-inline-size: none; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.23; }
  .client-story__description { max-inline-size: none; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; }
  .client-story__metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; max-inline-size: none; margin-inline-start: 0; }
  .client-story__button { margin-block-start: 32px; margin-inline-start: 0; }
  .client-story__media { min-block-size: 0; aspect-ratio: 1; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
.client-story__card { inline-size: calc(100% - 40px); }
  .client-story__card::before { inline-size: 8px; }
  .client-story__copy, [dir='rtl'] .client-story__copy { padding: 28px 20px; padding-inline-start: 28px; }
  .client-story__eyebrow { font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; }
  .client-story__heading { font-size: clamp(26px, 7.2vw, 32px); line-height: 1.23; }
  .client-story__description { margin-block-start: 20px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 26px; }
  .client-story__metrics { margin-block-start: 28px; gap: 20px 12px; }
  .client-story__button { font-size: 16px; padding-inline: 18px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
.client-story.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "max_blocks": 6,
  "name": "t:client_story.name",
  "disabled_on": {
    "groups": [
      "header",
      "footer"
    ]
  },
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "_client-story-metric"
    }
  ],
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "eyebrow",
      "label": "t:client_story.eyebrow",
      "default": "FEATURED CLIENT STORY"
    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "id": "heading",
      "label": "t:client_story.heading",
      "default": "[Client] achieved [core business result] with [service]."
    },
    {
      "type": "richtext",
      "id": "description",
      "label": "t:client_story.description",
      "default": "<p>Summarise the client context, the ME approach and the verified business outcome in one concise paragraph.</p>"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image",
      "label": "t:client_story.image"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image_mobile",
      "label": "t:client_story.image_mobile"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "image_alt",
      "label": "t:client_story.image_alt"
    },
    {
      "type": "text",
      "id": "link_label",
      "label": "t:client_story.link_label",
      "default": "Vlaw Case Study"
    },
    {
      "type": "url",
      "id": "link",
      "label": "t:client_story.link",
      "info": "t:client_story.link_info"
    },
    {
      "type": "font_picker",
      "id": "font",
      "label": "t:client_story.font",
      "default": "montserrat_n5"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "text_color",
      "label": "t:client_story.text_color",
      "default": "#000000"
    },
    {
      "type": "color_background",
      "id": "heading_gradient",
      "label": "t:client_story.heading_gradient",
      "default": "linear-gradient(108.133deg, #0B22B8 11.742%, #9621C4 88.258%)"
    },
    {
      "type": "color_background",
      "id": "background",
      "label": "t:client_story.background",
      "info": "t:client_story.background_info"
    },
    {
      "type": "color_background",
      "id": "panel_background",
      "label": "t:client_story.panel_background",
      "default": "linear-gradient(105.9376deg, rgba(19,98,250,0.05) 3.7241%, rgba(109,40,217,0.05) 96.276%)"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "accent_color",
      "label": "t:client_story.accent_color",
      "default": "#6D28D9"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "media_background",
      "label": "t:client_story.media_background",
      "default": "#FDFDFD"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "button_background",
      "label": "t:client_story.button_background",
      "default": "#6D28D9"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "button_text_color",
      "label": "t:client_story.button_text_color",
      "default": "#FFFFFF"
    },
    {
      "type": "range",
      "id": "card_radius",
      "label": "t:client_story.card_radius",
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 2,
      "unit": "px",
      "default": 28
    },
    {
      "type": "range",
      "id": "padding-block-start",
      "label": "t:client_story.padding_top",
      "min": 0,
      "max": 160,
      "step": 4,
      "unit": "px",
      "default": 60
    },
    {
      "type": "range",
      "id": "padding-block-end",
      "label": "t:client_story.padding_bottom",
      "min": 0,
      "max": 160,
      "step": 4,
      "unit": "px",
      "default": 60
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "enable_reveal",
      "label": "t:client_story.enable_reveal",
      "default": false
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:client_story.name",
      "category": "t:categories.storytelling",
      "blocks": {
        "metric_1": {
          "type": "_client-story-metric",
          "settings": {
            "value": "[XX%]",
            "label": "Primary result"
          }
        },
        "metric_2": {
          "type": "_client-story-metric",
          "settings": {

          }
        },

          }
        },

          }
        }
      },
      "block_order": [
        "metric_1",
        "metric_2",
        "metric_3",
        "metric_4"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

## sections/footer-diagnosis.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Growth diagnosis footer.
  Renders the CTA (marketing copy + feature list) and a native Shopify contact
  form in a white card, a four-column menu area, and a locations area anchored
  to the right half on desktop, all on one continuous gradient background.
  @example
  <!-- Added to the footer group; edit copy, pick menus, and set locations -->
  NOTES:
  - Styles live in this section's {% stylesheet %} (Horizon pattern, scoped to
    .footer-diagnosis) instead of a standalone asset, so they are delivered with
    the section response.
{% endcomment %}

<script
  src="{{ 'footer-diagnosis.js' | asset_url }}"
  type="module"
  fetchpriority="low"
></script>

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign form_id = 'FooterDiagnosis-' | append: section.id
  assign form_anchor_id = section_settings.form_anchor_id | strip | remove: '#' | handleize
%}



<div class="section-background footer-diagnosis__background"></div>

<div
  class="section section--page-width footer-diagnosis spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --fd-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
    --fd-bg-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
    --fd-bg-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
    --fd-card-bg: {{ section_settings.card_background }};
    --fd-card-radius: {{ section_settings.card_radius }}px;
    --fd-input-radius: {{ section_settings.input_radius }}px;
    --fd-btn-from: {{ section_settings.button_gradient_start }};
    --fd-btn-to: {{ section_settings.button_gradient_end }};
    --fd-section-gap: {{ section_settings.section_spacing }}px;
    --fd-column-gap: {{ section_settings.desktop_column_gap }}px;
  "
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  <div class="footer-diagnosis__top">
    <div class="footer-diagnosis__intro">
      {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank %}
        <p class="footer-diagnosis__eyebrow">{{ section_settings.eyebrow }}</p>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.heading != blank %}
        <div class="footer-diagnosis__heading rte">{{ section_settings.heading }}</div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="footer-diagnosis__description rte">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}

      {%- capture features -%}
        {% for block in section.blocks limit: 11 %}
          {%- if block.type == 'feature' -%}
            {%- liquid
              assign feature_icon = block.settings.icon
              assign custom_icon = block.settings.custom_icon
            -%}
            <li class="footer-diagnosis__feature" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
              <span class="footer-diagnosis__feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                {%- if custom_icon != blank -%}
                  {{
                    custom_icon
                    | image_url: width: 80
                    | image_tag: widths: '40, 80', sizes: '20px', loading: 'lazy', alt: ''
                  }}
                {%- else -%}
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" focusable="false">
                    {%- case feature_icon -%}
                      {%- when 'arrow_up_right' -%}
                        <path d="M7 17 17 7" /><path d="M8 7h9v9" />
                      {%- when 'browser' -%}
                        <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2" /><path d="M3 9h18" />
                      {%- when 'shield' -%}
                        <path d="M12 3l7 3v6c0 4.2-3 7-7 9-4-2-7-4.8-7-9V6z" />
                      {%- else -%}
                        <path d="m5 12 5 5 9-11" />
                    {%- endcase -%}
                  </svg>
                {%- endif -%}
              </span>
              <span class="footer-diagnosis__feature-text">{{ block.settings.text }}</span>
            </li>
          {%- endif -%}
        {% endfor %}
      {%- endcapture -%}

      {% if features != blank %}
        <ul class="footer-diagnosis__features">{{ features }}</ul>
      {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% render 'custom-footer-diagnosis-form', section_settings: section_settings, form_id: form_id, form_anchor_id: form_anchor_id %}
  </div>

  {%- capture menus -%}
    {% for block in section.blocks limit: 11 %}
      {%- if block.type == 'menu_column' -%}
        <div class="footer-diagnosis__menu" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
          {% if block.settings.heading != blank %}
            <p class="footer-diagnosis__menu-title">{{ block.settings.heading }}</p>
          {% endif %}
          {% if block.settings.menu != blank and block.settings.menu.links.size > 0 %}
            <ul>
              {% for link in block.settings.menu.links limit: 50 %}
                <li>
                  <a href="{{ link.url }}">{{ link.title }}</a>
                </li>
              {% endfor %}
            </ul>
          {% elsif request.design_mode %}
            <p class="footer-diagnosis__menu-empty">{{ 'content.select_menu' | t }}</p>
          {% endif %}
        </div>
      {%- endif -%}
    {% endfor %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if menus != blank %}
    <div class="footer-diagnosis__menus">{{ menus }}</div>
  {% endif %}

  {%- capture locations -%}
    {% for block in section.blocks limit: 11 %}
      {%- if block.type == 'location' -%}
        <div class="footer-diagnosis__location" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
          {% if block.settings.city != blank %}
            <p class="footer-diagnosis__location-city">{{ block.settings.city }}</p>
          {% endif %}
          {% if block.settings.address != blank %}
            <div class="footer-diagnosis__location-address">{{ block.settings.address }}</div>
          {% endif %}
        </div>
      {%- endif -%}
    {% endfor %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if locations != blank %}
    <div class="footer-diagnosis__locations">
      {% if section_settings.locations_heading != blank %}
        <p class="footer-diagnosis__locations-title">{{ section_settings.locations_heading }}</p>
      {% endif %}
      <div class="footer-diagnosis__locations-grid">{{ locations }}</div>
    </div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .footer-diagnosis__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--fd-bg-angle, 120deg),
      var(--fd-bg-from, #0048ff) 6.48%,
      var(--fd-bg-to, #f200ff40) 100.95%
    );
  }

  .footer-diagnosis {
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__top {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.88fr) minmax(0, 1.12fr);
    gap: var(--fd-column-gap, 48px);
    align-items: start;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__intro {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 38px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__heading {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 46.1px;
    line-height: 54px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__heading > :first-child,
  .footer-diagnosis__heading > :last-child {
    margin-block: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__description {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 120%;
letter-spacing: normal;

  }

  .footer-diagnosis__description > :first-child,
  .footer-diagnosis__description > :last-child {
    margin-block: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__features {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 21px;
    margin: 12px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__feature {
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 100%;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__feature-icon {
    display: grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: center;
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    background-color: #7088FE;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__feature-icon svg,
  .footer-diagnosis__feature-icon img {
    display: block;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__card {
    display: block;
    scroll-margin-block-start: calc(var(--header-group-height, 0px) + 24px);
    padding: 46px 42px;
    color: #111111;
    background-color: var(--fd-card-bg, #FBFBFB);
    border-radius: var(--fd-card-radius, 40px);
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__form {
    display: block;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__fields {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 30px 19px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__field {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 11px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__field--full {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__label {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 100%;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    color:#000000;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__input {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 36px;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #878787;
    border-radius: var(--fd-input-radius, 16px);
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__input::placeholder {
    color: #9aa0b4;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__input:focus-visible {
    border-color: #6e5bf0;
    outline: 2px solid #6e5bf0;
    outline-offset: 1px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__input--textarea {
    min-height: 132px;
    resize: vertical;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__submit {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 62px;
    padding: 13px 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 36px;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    color: #ffffff;
    cursor: pointer;
    background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--fd-btn-from, #9b3cf0) 0%, var(--fd-btn-to, #4e63f0) 100%);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__submit[aria-disabled='true'] {
    opacity: 0.7;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__error,
  .footer-diagnosis__success {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__error {
    color: #b00020;
    background-color: #fde8ec;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__success {
    color: #0b6b3a;
    background-color: #e7f7ee;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menus {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--fd-column-gap, 48px);
    margin-block-start: var(--fd-section-gap,70px);
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu-title {
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 21px;
    line-height: 25.2px;
    letter-spacing: -0.99px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu ul {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu a {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu a:hover,
  .footer-diagnosis__menu a:focus-visible {
    opacity: 0.8;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__menu-empty {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    opacity: 0.8;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__locations {
    margin-block-start: var(--fd-section-gap, 56px);
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__locations-title {
    margin: 0 0 20px;
    font-family: var(--font-body--family);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 21px;
    line-height: 25.2px;
    letter-spacing: -0.99px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__locations-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__location {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__location-city {
    margin: 0 0 14px;
    font-family: var(--font-body--family);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 16.8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.15px;
  }

  .footer-diagnosis__location-address {
   font-family: var(--font-body--family);
   font-weight: 400;
   font-size: 14px;
   line-height: 22.4px;
   letter-spacing: -0.15px;
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {
    /* Desktop: the locations block sits in the right half, not centered. */
    .footer-diagnosis__locations {
      margin-inline-start: 50%;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {
    .footer-diagnosis__top {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__heading {
      font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__menus {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 32px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .footer-diagnosis__card {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__fields {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__heading {
      font-size: 1.75rem;
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__description {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
    }

    .footer-diagnosis__locations-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 479px) {
    .footer-diagnosis__locations-grid {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/hero.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Hero section. Owns responsive image/video media and merchant-managed content blocks.
  The growth layout uses the same media pickers and block IDs with a homepage composition.
  @example
  <!-- Select the Growth hero layout and configure image/video media and content blocks. -->
{% endcomment %}


{% liquid
  # Native layout also reuses the existing viewport-gated video component.
  assign video_controls = true
  assign video_autoplay = false
  assign video_preload = 'none'
  if section.settings.layout_style == 'growth'
    assign video_controls = true
    assign video_autoplay = false
    assign video_preload = 'none'
  endif
  assign media_count = 0
  assign media_count_mobile = 0
  assign fallback_to_desktop = false
  assign media_1 = 'none'
  assign media_2 = 'none'
  assign media_1_mobile = 'none'
  assign media_2_mobile = 'none'
  assign has_only_video = false
  assign has_only_video_mobile = false

  # Desktop media checks
  # For each media slot, check if the media is not blank and the media type matches the slot
  # Need to check both (1) media picker is not blank AND (2) section.setting.media_type because user can toggle between different media types to display, but choosing "Image" doesn't clear a saved "Video" in the theme editor.
  # The alternate setting (section.settings.image_1 when "Video" is selected) is only visually hidden in theme editor.
  if section.settings.image_1 != blank and section.settings.media_type_1 == 'image'
    assign media_1 = 'image'
    assign media_count = media_count | plus: 1
  endif
  if section.settings.video_1 != blank and section.settings.media_type_1 == 'video'
    assign media_1 = 'video'
    assign media_count = media_count | plus: 1
  endif
  if section.settings.image_2 != blank and section.settings.media_type_2 == 'image'
    assign media_2 = 'image'
    assign media_count = media_count | plus: 1
  endif
  if section.settings.video_2 != blank and section.settings.media_type_2 == 'video'
    assign media_2 = 'video'
    assign media_count = media_count | plus: 1
  endif

  if section.settings.custom_mobile_media
    # Mobile media checks
    # For each media slot, check if the media is not blank and the media type matches the slot
    if section.settings.image_1_mobile != blank and section.settings.media_type_1_mobile == 'image'
      assign media_1_mobile = 'image'
      assign media_count_mobile = media_count_mobile | plus: 1
    endif
    if section.settings.video_1_mobile != blank and section.settings.media_type_1_mobile == 'video'
      assign media_1_mobile = 'video'
      assign media_count_mobile = media_count_mobile | plus: 1
    endif
    if section.settings.image_2_mobile != blank and section.settings.media_type_2_mobile == 'image'
      assign media_2_mobile = 'image'
      assign media_count_mobile = media_count_mobile | plus: 1
    endif
    if section.settings.video_2_mobile != blank and section.settings.media_type_2_mobile == 'video'
      assign media_2_mobile = 'video'
      assign media_count_mobile = media_count_mobile | plus: 1
    endif
  endif
  if media_count > 0 and media_1 != 'image' and media_2 != 'image'
    assign has_only_video = true
  endif
  if media_count > 0 and media_count_mobile > 0 and media_1_mobile != 'image' and media_2_mobile != 'image'
    assign has_only_video_mobile = true
  endif

  assign media_wrapper_desktop_class = 'hero__media-wrapper hero__media-wrapper--desktop'
  assign media_wrapper_mobile_class = 'hero__media-wrapper hero__media-wrapper--mobile'
  # If there is no custom mobile media to show, we add the mobile class to the desktop classes so content is always shown on mobile.
  if section.settings.custom_mobile_media == false or section.settings.custom_mobile_media == true and media_count_mobile == 0
    assign media_wrapper_desktop_class = media_wrapper_desktop_class | append: ' hero__media-wrapper--mobile'
  endif

  # Should we show the blurred reflection on mobile?
  assign show_mobile_blurred_reflection = false
  if section.settings.blurred_reflection
    if section.settings.custom_mobile_media == true and media_count_mobile > 0 and has_only_video_mobile == false
      # Custom mobile media is active and a mobile image is present
      assign show_mobile_blurred_reflection = true
    elsif section.settings.custom_mobile_media == true and media_count_mobile == 0 and media_count > 0 and has_only_video == false
      # Custom mobile media is active, no mobile media is present, but a desktop image is present
      assign show_mobile_blurred_reflection = true
    elsif section.settings.custom_mobile_media == false and media_count > 0 and has_only_video == false
      # Custom mobile media is inactive, but a desktop image is present
      assign show_mobile_blurred_reflection = true
    endif
  endif

  if media_1 == 'image' and media_2 == 'image'
    assign media_width_desktop = '50vw'
  else
    assign media_width_desktop = '100vw'
  endif

  # If custom mobile media is disabled or no mobile media is present, we need to fallback to desktop media.
  if section.settings.custom_mobile_media == false or media_count_mobile == 0 or media_count == 0
    assign media_count_mobile = media_count
    assign fallback_to_desktop = true
  endif

  if fallback_to_desktop
    assign media_width_mobile = media_width_desktop
  elsif section.settings.stack_media_on_mobile or media_1_mobile != 'image' or media_2_mobile != 'image'
    assign media_width_mobile = '100vw'
  else
    assign media_width_mobile = '50vw'
  endif

  assign sizes = '(min-width: 750px) ' | append: media_width_desktop | append: ', ' | append: media_width_mobile
  assign widths = '832, 1200, 1600, 1920, 2560, 3840'
  assign sizes_mobile = media_width_mobile
  assign mobile_widths = '416, 600, 800, 1200, 1600'
  assign mobile_widths_array = mobile_widths | split: ', '

  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  assign secondary_fetch_priority = 'auto'
  assign hero_media_id = 'HeroMedia-' | append: section.id
  assign has_hero_video = false
  if media_1 == 'video' or media_2 == 'video' or media_1_mobile == 'video' or media_2_mobile == 'video'
    assign has_hero_video = true
  endif
  assign hero_poster = section.settings.video_1.preview_image | default: section.settings.video_2.preview_image
  assign fetch_priority = 'auto'

  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
    assign fetch_priority = 'high'
    if media_1 == 'none'
      assign secondary_fetch_priority = 'high'
    endif
  endif
%}

{% capture media_slot_1 %}
  {%- if media_1 == 'image' and media_1_mobile == 'image' -%}
    {%- comment -%} Both desktop and mobile are images. Assume similar images, and this is art direction: use picture element. {%- endcomment -%}
    <picture
      data-testid="hero-picture-1"
      class="hero__media"
    >
      <source
        media="(max-width: 749px)"
        srcset="
          {%-  for mobile_width in mobile_widths_array -%}
            {{ section.settings.image_1_mobile | image_url: width: mobile_width }} {{ mobile_width }}w{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}
          {%- endfor -%}
        "
        sizes="{{ sizes_mobile }}"
        width="{{ section.settings.image_1_mobile.width }}"
        height="{{ section.settings.image_1_mobile.height }}"
      >
      {{
        section.settings.image_1
        | image_url: width: 3840
        | image_tag:
          width: section.settings.image_1.width,
          widths: widths,
          height: section.settings.image_1.height,
          alt: section.settings.image_1.alt,
          class: 'hero__media',
          sizes: sizes,
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          fetchpriority: fetch_priority,
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-image-1'
      }}
    </picture>
  {%- elsif media_1 == 'image' -%}
    <div class="{{ media_wrapper_desktop_class }}">
      {{
        section.settings.image_1
        | image_url: width: 3840
        | image_tag:
          width: section.settings.image_1.width,
          widths: widths,
          height: section.settings.image_1.height,
          alt: section.settings.image_1.alt,
          class: 'hero__media',
          sizes: sizes,
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          fetchpriority: fetch_priority,
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-image-1'
      }}
    </div>
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- if media_1 == 'video' -%}
    <div class="{{ media_wrapper_desktop_class }}">
      {{
        section.settings.video_1
        | video_tag:
          poster: nil,
          autoplay: video_autoplay,
          loop: true,
          controls: video_controls,
          preload: video_preload,
          muted: true,
          class: 'hero__media',
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-video-1'
      }}
    </div>
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- comment -%} Mobile-only slot 1 media (when desktop is different type) {%- endcomment -%}
  {%- if media_count > 0 and media_count_mobile > 0 -%}
    {%- if media_1_mobile == 'image' and media_1 != 'image' -%}
      <div class="{{ media_wrapper_mobile_class }}">
        {{
          section.settings.image_1_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag:
            width: section.settings.image_1_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_1_mobile.height,
            alt: section.settings.image_1_mobile.alt,
            class: 'hero__media',
            sizes: sizes_mobile,
            loading: image_loading,
            decoding: 'async',
            fetchpriority: fetch_priority,
            data-testid: 'hero-mobile-image-1'
        }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}

    {%- if media_1_mobile == 'video' -%}
      <div class="{{ media_wrapper_mobile_class }}">
        {{
          section.settings.video_1_mobile
          | video_tag:
            poster: nil,
            autoplay: video_autoplay,
            loop: true,
            controls: video_controls,
          preload: video_preload,
            muted: true,
            class: 'hero__media',
            data-testid: 'hero-mobile-video-1'
        }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{% endcapture %}

{% capture media_slot_2 %}
  {%- if media_2 == 'image' and media_2_mobile == 'image' -%}
    {%- comment -%} Both desktop and mobile are images. Assume this is art direction: use picture element.  {%- endcomment -%}
    <picture
      class="hero__media"
      data-testid="hero-picture-2"
    >
      <source
        media="(max-width: 749px)"
        srcset="
          {%-  for mobile_width in mobile_widths_array -%}
            {{ section.settings.image_2_mobile | image_url: width: mobile_width }} {{ mobile_width }}w{% unless forloop.last%},{% endunless %}
          {%- endfor -%}
        "
        sizes="{{ sizes_mobile }}"
        width="{{ section.settings.image_2_mobile.width }}"
        height="{{ section.settings.image_2_mobile.height }}"
      >
      {{
        section.settings.image_2
        | image_url: width: 3840
        | image_tag:
          width: section.settings.image_2.width,
          widths: widths,
          height: section.settings.image_2.height,
          alt: section.settings.image_2.alt,
          class: 'hero__media',
          sizes: sizes,
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          fetchpriority: secondary_fetch_priority,
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-image-2'
      }}
    </picture>
  {%- elsif media_2 == 'image' -%}
    <div class="{{ media_wrapper_desktop_class }}">
      {{
        section.settings.image_2
        | image_url: width: 3840
        | image_tag:
          width: section.settings.image_2.width,
          widths: widths,
          height: section.settings.image_2.height,
          alt: section.settings.image_2.alt,
          class: 'hero__media',
          sizes: sizes,
          loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
          fetchpriority: secondary_fetch_priority,
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-image-2'
      }}
    </div>
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- if media_2 == 'video' -%}
    <div class="{{ media_wrapper_desktop_class }}">
      {{
        section.settings.video_2
        | video_tag:
          poster: nil,
          autoplay: video_autoplay,
          loop: true,
          controls: video_controls,
          preload: video_preload,
          muted: true,
          class: 'hero__media',
          data-testid: 'hero-desktop-video-2'
      }}
    </div>
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- comment -%} Mobile-only slot 2 media (when desktop is different type) {%- endcomment -%}
  {%- if media_count > 0 and media_count_mobile > 0 -%}
    {%- if media_2_mobile == 'image' and media_2 != 'image' -%}
      <div class="{{ media_wrapper_mobile_class }}">
        {{
          section.settings.image_2_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag:
            width: section.settings.image_2_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_2_mobile.height,
            alt: section.settings.image_2_mobile.alt,
            class: 'hero__media',
            sizes: sizes_mobile,
            loading: image_loading,
            decoding: 'async',
            fetchpriority: secondary_fetch_priority,
            data-testid: 'hero-mobile-image-2'
        }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}

    {%- if media_2_mobile == 'video' -%}
      <div class="{{ media_wrapper_mobile_class }}">
        {{
          section.settings.video_2_mobile
          | video_tag:
            poster: nil,
            autoplay: video_autoplay,
            loop: true,
            controls: video_controls,
          preload: video_preload,
            muted: true,
            class: 'hero__media',
            data-testid: 'hero-mobile-video-2'
        }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{% endcapture %}

{% capture media %}
  {{ media_slot_1 }}
  {{ media_slot_2 }}

  {% if media_count == 0 %}
    {% if section.settings.layout_style == 'growth' %}
      <img src="{{ 'growth-hero-background.png' | asset_url }}" class="hero__media" width="1440" height="735" alt="" decoding="async" loading="{{ image_loading }}" fetchpriority="{{ fetch_priority }}">
    {% else %}
      {{ 'hero-apparel-1' | placeholder_svg_tag: 'hero__media' }}
    {% endif %}
  {%- endif -%}
{% endcapture %}

{% if section.settings.blurred_reflection %}
{% capture media_blurred %}
  {% if media_1 == 'image' %}
    {{
      section.settings.image_1
      | image_url: width: 3840
      | image_tag:
        width: section.settings.image_1.width,
        widths: widths,
        height: section.settings.image_1.height,
        alt: '',
        class: 'hero__media',
        sizes: sizes
    }}
  {% endif %}
  {% if media_2 == 'image' %}
    {{
      section.settings.image_2
      | image_url: width: 3840
      | image_tag:
        width: section.settings.image_2.width,
        widths: widths,
        height: section.settings.image_2.height,
        alt: '',
        class: 'hero__media',
        sizes: sizes
    }}
  {% endif %}
  {% if media_count == 0 %}
    {{ 'hero-apparel-1' | placeholder_svg_tag: 'hero__media' }}
  {% endif %}
{% endcapture %}

{% capture mobile_media_blurred %}
  {% render 'custom-hero-mobile-reflection', section: section, fallback_to_desktop: fallback_to_desktop, media_1_mobile: media_1_mobile, media_2_mobile: media_2_mobile, media_blurred: media_blurred, mobile_widths: mobile_widths, sizes_mobile: sizes_mobile, media_count: media_count, media_2: media_2, media_1: media_1, widths: widths, sizes: sizes %}
{% endcapture %}

{% endif %}

{% capture hero_blocks %}
  {% content_for 'blocks' %}
{% endcapture %}

{% if section.settings.layout_style == 'growth' %}
  {% render 'growth-hero', section: section, children: hero_blocks, media: media, media_count: media_count, media_count_mobile: media_count_mobile %}
{% else %}
{%- liquid
  if section.settings.background_color != blank
    render 'contrast-override', background_color: section.settings.background_color, section_id: section.id, skip_contrast: true
  endif
-%}

{% # A first-section hero consumes `--header-group-height` at first paint (`.hero-wrapper:first-child` rule below) %}
{% render 'measure-header-heights', only_when_first_section: true %}

{% if has_hero_video %}<script src="{{ 'growth-hero.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>{% endif %}
<growth-hero-component
  id="Hero-{{ section.id }}"
  class="hero{% if section.settings.background_color != blank %} color-custom-{{ section.id }}{% endif %}{% if section.blocks.size == 0 and section.settings.section_height == 'auto' %} hero--no-blocks-auto-height{% endif %}{% if section.settings.stack_media_on_mobile %} hero--stack-mobile{% endif %}"
  style="
    --hero-border-style: {{ section.settings.border }};
    --hero-border-width: {{ section.settings.border_width }}px;
    --hero-border-opacity: {{ section.settings.border_opacity }}%;
    --blur-opacity: {{ section.settings.reflection_opacity | divided_by: 100.0 }};
    {% if section.settings.section_height == 'custom' %}
      --hero-min-height: {{ section.settings.section_height_custom }}svh;
    {% elsif section.settings.section_height == "full-screen" %}
       --hero-min-height: 100svh;
    {% else %}
      --hero-min-height: var(--section-height-{{ section.settings.section_height }});
    {% endif %}
  "
  {% if request.visual_preview_mode %}
    data-shopify-visual-preview
  {% endif %}
  {% if section.settings.blurred_reflection and has_only_video == false or has_only_video_mobile == false %}
    data-blur-shadow="true"
  {% endif %}
>
  {% if section.settings.blurred_reflection %}
    {% unless has_only_video %}
      <div
        class="hero__blurred-image hero__blurred-image--desktop"
        data-testid="hero-blurred-image-desktop"
      >
        {{ media_blurred }}
      </div>
    {% endunless %}
    {% if show_mobile_blurred_reflection %}
      <div
        class="hero__blurred-image hero__blurred-image--mobile"
        data-testid="hero-blurred-image-mobile"
      >
        {{ mobile_media_blurred }}
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  {% endif %}

  {% comment %}
    Hardcoded to section--full-width bc the media has to be full width in all cases.
    hero__content-wrapper applies section_width.
  {% endcomment %}

  <div
    class="hero__container spacing-style section section--full-width"
    style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section.settings %}"
  >
    {%- if section.settings.link != blank -%}
      <a
        href="{{ section.settings.link }}"
        class="hero__link"
        {% if section.settings.open_in_new_tab %}
          target="_blank" rel="noopener"
        {% endif %}
      ></a>
    {%- endif -%}
    {% if has_hero_video and hero_poster != blank %}
      {% assign hero_poster_priority = 'auto' %}
      {% if media_1 != 'image' %}{% assign hero_poster_priority = fetch_priority %}{% endif %}
      {{ hero_poster | image_url: width: 1920 | image_tag: widths: '750,1100,1500,1920', sizes: '100vw', loading: image_loading, fetchpriority: hero_poster_priority, decoding: 'async', class: 'hero__video-poster', alt: '' }}
    {% endif %}
    <div
      id="{{ hero_media_id }}" ref="media"
      class="hero__media-grid"
      style="--hero-media-count: {{ media_count }};--hero-media-count-mobile: {{ media_count_mobile }};{%- if section.settings.image_1 != blank -%} --hero-media-aspect-ratio: {{ section.settings.image_1.aspect_ratio }};{% endif %}"
      data-testid="hero-media-wrapper"
    >
      {% liquid
        if section.settings.toggle_overlay
          render 'overlay', settings: section.settings
        endif
      %}
      {{ media }}
    </div>
    <div
      class="
        hero__content-wrapper
        layout-panel-flex
        layout-panel-flex--{{ section.settings.content_direction }}
        {% if section.settings.vertical_on_mobile %}mobile-column{% endif %}
        section-content-wrapper
        {{section.settings.section_width}}
        {% if request.design_mode %}hero__content-wrapper--design-mode{% endif %}
      "
      style="{% render 'layout-panel-style', settings: section.settings %}"
    >
      {{ hero_blocks }}
    </div>
  </div>
  {% if has_hero_video %}{% render 'custom-hero-video-controls', media_id: hero_media_id %}{% endif %}
</growth-hero-component>

{% endif %}

{% stylesheet %}
  .hero-wrapper {
    --hero-height-offset: 0px;
  }

  /* Being extra specific in the selector for performance reasons.
     Header-dependent page rules use #header-group as the :has() subject and reach the page with `~`.
     With body as the subject, every [open] or [aria-expanded] change in the header restyles the whole page. */
  #header-group:has(> .header-section > #header-component) ~ * .hero-wrapper:first-child {
    --hero-height-offset: var(--header-group-height, 0);
  }

  .hero {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    min-height: calc(var(--hero-min-height) - var(--hero-height-offset));
  }

  .hero[data-shopify-visual-preview] {
    --hero-min-height: 600px;

    min-height: 600px;
  }

  .hero__container {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: var(--hero-border-width) var(--hero-border-style) rgb(var(--color-border-rgb) / var(--hero-border-opacity));
    min-height: inherit;
    align-items: var(--vertical-alignment-mobile);
    justify-content: var(--horizontal-alignment);
    z-index: var(--layer-base);

    @media screen and (min-width: 750px) {
      align-items: var(--vertical-alignment);
    }
  }

  .hero__content-wrapper.page-width {
    grid-column: 2 / 3;
  }

  .hero__content-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: var(--layer-flat);
  }

  .hero__content-wrapper .group-block-content {
    position: relative;
  }

  .hero__media-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--hero-media-count, 1), 1fr);
  }

  .hero--auto .hero__media {
    aspect-ratio: var(--hero-media-aspect-ratio);
  }

  .hero--no-blocks-auto-height {
    .hero__media {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: auto;
    }

    .hero__media-grid {
      /* When there are no blocks and the height is auto, allow the image to appear. */
      position: relative;
    }
  }

  .hero__media-wrapper {
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }

  .hero__media {
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center center;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    z-index: var(--layer-base);
  }

  /* Mobile/Desktop media visibility */

  .hero__media-wrapper--mobile {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero__media-wrapper--desktop {
    display: block;
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .hero__media-wrapper--desktop {
      display: none;
    }

    .hero__media-wrapper--mobile {
      display: block;
    }

    .hero__media-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--hero-media-count-mobile, 1), 1fr);
    }

    /* Mobile stacking */
    .hero--stack-mobile .hero__media-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: repeat(var(--hero-media-count-mobile, 1), calc(100% / var(--hero-media-count-mobile, 1)));
    }
  }

  .hero__link {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .hero__media-grid,
  .hero__content-wrapper {
    pointer-events: none;

    :is(a, button, input, textarea, select, details, summary) {
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    /*
     * App blocks own their interactive markup, and an app is free to render it into a shadow
     * root that no selector here can reach. Restoring pointer events on the app block wrapper
     * covers both cases, because pointer-events inherits into the shadow tree.
     */
    .shopify-app-block {
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
  }

  .hero__content-wrapper--design-mode * {
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .hero[data-blur-shadow='true'] {
    --blurred-reflection-filter-saturate: saturate(1.5);
    --blurred-reflection-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 0%, #000 60%, transparent 100%);
    --blurred-reflection-box-shadow: rgb(0 0 0 / 5%) 0 0 1rem;
    --blurred-reflection-filter-blur: blur(20px);
    --blurred-reflection-scale: scale(2, 1.25);
    --blurred-reflection-padding-block-end: 60px;
  }

  .hero[data-blur-shadow='true'] .hero__container::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    box-shadow: var(--blurred-reflection-box-shadow);
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -1;
  }

  .hero__blurred-image {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    mask-image: var(--blurred-reflection-mask-image);
    filter: var(--blurred-reflection-filter-saturate);
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(50%);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero__blurred-image--desktop {
    display: none;

    @media screen and (min-width: 750px) {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  .hero__blurred-image--mobile {
    display: block;

    @media screen and (min-width: 750px) {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .hero__blurred-image img,
  .hero__blurred-image svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center center;
    filter: var(--blurred-reflection-filter-blur);
    opacity: var(--blur-opacity);
    transform: var(--blurred-reflection-scale);
    padding-block-end: var(--blurred-reflection-padding-block-end);

    &:not(:only-child) {
      width: 50%;

      &:last-child {
        inset-inline-end: 0;
        inset-inline-start: auto;
      }
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "max_blocks": 50,
  "name": "t:names.hero",
  "tag": "section",
  "class": "hero-wrapper section-wrapper",
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "@theme"
    },
    {
      "type": "text"
    },
    {
      "type": "button"
    },
    {
      "type": "logo"
    },
    {
      "type": "jumbo-text"
    },
    {
      "type": "spacer"
    },
    {
      "type": "group"
    },
    {
      "type": "_marquee"
    }
  ],
  "disabled_on": {
    "groups": [
      "header"
    ]
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "layout_style",
      "label": "t:settings.style",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "standard",
          "label": "t:options.default"
        },
        {
          "value": "growth",
          "label": "t:options.growth_hero"
        }
      ],
      "default": "standard"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.media_1"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "media_type_1",
      "label": "t:settings.type",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "image",
          "label": "t:options.image"
        },
        {
          "value": "video",
          "label": "t:options.video"
        }
      ],
      "default": "image"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image_1",
      "label": "t:settings.image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.media_type_1 == 'image' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "video",
      "id": "video_1",
      "label": "t:settings.video",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.media_type_1 == 'video' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.media_2"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "media_type_2",
      "label": "t:settings.type",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "image",
          "label": "t:options.image"
        },
        {
          "value": "video",
          "label": "t:options.video"
        }
      ],
      "default": "image"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image_2",
      "label": "t:settings.image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.media_type_2 == 'image' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "video",
      "id": "video_2",
      "label": "t:settings.video",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.media_type_2 == 'video' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.mobile_media"
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "stack_media_on_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.stack_media_on_mobile",
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "custom_mobile_media",
      "label": "t:settings.custom_mobile_media",
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.mobile_media_1",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "media_type_1_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.type",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "image",
          "label": "t:options.image"
        },
        {
          "value": "video",
          "label": "t:options.video"
        }
      ],
      "default": "image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image_1_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media and section.settings.media_type_1_mobile == 'image' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "video",
      "id": "video_1_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.video",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media and section.settings.media_type_1_mobile == 'video' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.mobile_media_2",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "media_type_2_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.type",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "image",
          "label": "t:options.image"
        },
        {
          "value": "video",
          "label": "t:options.video"
        }
      ],
      "default": "image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "image_picker",
      "id": "image_2_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.image",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media and section.settings.media_type_2_mobile == 'image' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "video",
      "id": "video_2_mobile",
      "label": "t:settings.video",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.custom_mobile_media and section.settings.media_type_2_mobile == 'video' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.section_link"
    },
    {
      "type": "url",
      "id": "link",
      "label": "t:settings.link"
    },
    {
      "type": "checkbox",
      "id": "open_in_new_tab",
      "label": "t:settings.open_new_tab",
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "type": "header",
      "content": "t:content.layout"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "content_direction",
      "label": "t:settings.direction",
      "options": [
        {
````
