## sections/insights.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Insights.
  Renders an eyebrow, a gradient headline, and supporting copy above a list of
  merchant-managed question blocks, plus an optional "view all" link, all on a
  full-bleed gradient background.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Insights" section, then edit each question block -->
{% endcomment %}

<script
  src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}"
  type="module"
  fetchpriority="low"
></script>

{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
  assign card_alpha = section_settings.card_opacity | divided_by: 100.0
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
  endif
  assign container_alpha = section_settings.container_opacity | divided_by: 100.0
%}



<div
  class="section-background insights__background"
  style="
    --insights-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
    --insights-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --insights-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
  "
></div>

<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--page-width insights spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --insights-heading-gap: {{ section_settings.heading_gap }}px;
    --insights-list-gap: {{ section_settings.list_gap }}px;
    --insights-media-width: {{ section_settings.media_width }}px;
    --insights-card-radius: {{ section_settings.card_radius }}px;
    --insights-link-color: {{ section_settings.link_color }};
    {% if section_settings.container_background != blank %}
      --insights-container-background: {{ section_settings.container_background | color_modify: 'alpha', container_alpha }};
    {% endif %}
    {% if section_settings.card_background != blank %}
      --insights-card-background: {{ section_settings.card_background | color_modify: 'alpha', card_alpha }};
    {% endif %}
  "
  data-reveal-scope
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank or heading_text != blank or section_settings.description != blank %}
    <div class="insights__intro" data-reveal>
      {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank %}
        <p class="insights__eyebrow">{{ section_settings.eyebrow }}</p>
      {% endif %}

      {% if heading_text != blank %}
        {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
        <div
          class="
            insights__heading
            text-block
            text-block--full-width
            custom-typography
            custom-font-size
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
          "
          style="
            {% render 'typography-style', settings: section_settings, type: 'heading', preset: 'custom' %}
            --text-align: {{ section_settings.alignment }};
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
              --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
              --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
              --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
              --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
              --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
            {% endif %}
          "
        >
          {{ heading_text }}
        </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="insights__description">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {%- liquid
    assign blog = section_settings.blog
    assign post_limit = section_settings.post_limit
  -%}

  {% if blog != blank and blog.articles_count > 0 %}
    <div class="insights__list">
      {%- for article in blog.articles limit: post_limit -%}
        {%- liquid
          assign image_alt = article.image.alt | default: article.title
          assign article_description = article.excerpt | default: article.content
          if article_description != blank
            assign article_description = article_description | strip_html | truncatewords: 30
          endif
        -%}
        <div class="insight-reveal" data-reveal>
          <a class="insight-row" href="{{ article.url }}" aria-label="{{ article.title | escape }}">
            <div class="insight-row__media">
              {%- if article.image != blank -%}
                {{
                  article.image
                  | image_url: width: 800
                  | image_tag:
                    widths: '260, 400, 600, 800',
                    sizes: '(min-width: 750px) 260px, 100vw',
                    loading: image_loading,
          decoding: 'async',
                    class: 'insight-row__image',
                    alt: image_alt
                }}
              {%- endif -%}
            </div>

            <div class="insight-row__body">
              <div class="insight-row__header">
                <p class="insight-row__title">{{ article.title }}</p>
                <span class="insight-row__read" aria-hidden="true">{{ section_settings.link_label }}</span>
              </div>

              {%- if article_description != blank -%}
                <div class="insight-row__answer">{{ article_description }}</div>
              {%- endif -%}
            </div>
          </a>
        </div>
      {%- endfor -%}
    </div>
  {% elsif request.design_mode %}
    <div class="insights__list">
      {%- for i in (1..post_limit) -%}
        <div class="insight-reveal" data-reveal>
          <div class="insight-row">
            <div class="insight-row__media"></div>
            <div class="insight-row__body">
              <div class="insight-row__header">
                <p class="insight-row__title">{{ 'content.select_article' | t }}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      {%- endfor -%}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {% if section_settings.view_all_link != blank and section_settings.view_all_label != blank %}
    <a class="insights__view-all" href="{{ section_settings.view_all_link }}">
      {{- section_settings.view_all_label -}}
    </a>
  {% endif %}
</scroll-reveal-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .insights__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--insights-bg-angle, 180deg),
      var(--insights-bg-from, #aac5ff) 0%,
      var(--insights-bg-to, #c9d5fd) 100%
    );
  }

  .insights__intro {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .insights__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .insights__heading {
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .insights__description {
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .insights__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .insights__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  .insights__list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--insights-list-gap, 16px);
    width: 100%;
    margin-block-start: var(--insights-heading-gap, 40px);
    padding: 48px 45px;
    background-color: var(--insights-container-background, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6));
    border-radius: var(--insights-card-radius, 27px);
  }

  .insights__view-all {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    justify-self: start;
    margin-block-start: 24px;
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 25px;
    color: var(--insights-link-color, #106EFA);
  }

  /* Underline via pseudo-element: hidden by default; draws in left-to-right on hover. */
  .insights__view-all::after,
  .insight-row__read::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    bottom: 0.3em;
    height: 1px;
    background-color: currentColor;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  }

  .insights__view-all:hover::after,
  .insight-row__read:hover::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .insights__view-all::after,
    .insight-row__read::after {
      transition: none;
    }
  }

  .insight-row {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    gap: 34px;
    padding: 18px 34px;
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    background-color: var(--insights-card-background, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8));
    border-radius: var(--insights-card-radius, 27px);
    box-shadow: 3px 4px 12.1px 0 #3c45e840;
  }

  .insight-row__media {
    position: relative;
    flex: 0 0 var(--insights-media-width, 260px);
    width: var(--insights-media-width, 260px);
    max-width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 366/175;
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      100.56deg,
      rgb(229 228 252 / 0.8) 1.45%,
      rgb(224 238 250 / 0.8) 98.55%
    );
    border-radius: var(--insights-card-radius, 27px);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .insight-row__image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .insight-row__body {
    max-width: 625px;
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .insight-row__header {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-inline-end: 74px;
  }

  .insight-row__title {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: #000000;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }

  .insight-row__read {
    position: absolute;
    top: 18px;
    inset-inline-end: 34px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 25px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .insight-row__answer {
    max-width: 625px;
    margin-block-start: 15px;
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #000000;
  }

  .insight-row__answer > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .insight-row__answer > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  /* Card hover: lift, deepen the shadow, and gently zoom the image. */
  @media (hover: hover) {
    .insight-row {
      transition:
        transform 0.35s var(--ease-out-cubic),
        box-shadow 0.35s var(--ease-out-cubic);
    }

    .insight-row:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 3px 10px 28px 0 #3c45e840;
    }

    .insight-row:hover .insight-row__read::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }

    .insight-row__image {
      transition: transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-cubic);
    }

    .insight-row:hover .insight-row__image {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .insight-row,
    .insight-row__image {
      transition: none;
    }

    .insight-row:hover {
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .insights__description {
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .insight-row {
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .insight-row__media {
      flex-basis: auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .insight-row__read {
      position: static;
    }

    .insight-row__header {
      padding-inline-end: 0;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/our-approach.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Our approach: responsive editorial copy and a merchant-selected reference image.
  Background is transparent unless explicitly set. Reveal reuses the theme lifecycle.
  @example Add "Our approach", choose the image, and edit the two paragraphs.
{% endcomment %}
{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
  assign desktop_image = s.image | default: s.image_mobile
  assign mobile_image = s.image_mobile | default: desktop_image
  assign image_alt = s.image_alt | default: desktop_image.alt
  assign image_loading = 'lazy'
  assign image_priority = 'auto'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign image_loading = 'eager'
    if section.index == 1
      assign image_priority = 'high'
    endif
  endif
%}
{% render 'custom-section-fonts', font: s.font %}
{% if s.enable_reveal %}
  <script src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>
  {% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}
{% endif %}
<div class="our-approach__background" style="background: {{ s.background | default: 'transparent' }};" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--full-width spacing-style our-approach{% if desktop_image == blank %} our-approach--text-only{% endif %}"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: s %}
    --our-approach-font: {{ s.font.family | escape }}, {{ s.font.fallback_families }};
    --our-approach-text: {{ s.text_color }};
    --our-approach-gradient: {{ s.heading_gradient | default: '#0B22B8' }};
    --our-approach-mobile-top: {{ s.padding_mobile_top }}px;
    --our-approach-mobile-bottom: {{ s.padding_mobile_bottom }}px;"
  {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal-scope{% endif %}
>
  <div class="our-approach__inner">
    <div class="our-approach__copy" {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal{% endif %}>
      {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="our-approach__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
      {% if s.heading != blank %}<h2 class="our-approach__heading">{{ s.heading | escape | newline_to_br }}</h2>{% endif %}
      {% if s.body_primary != blank or s.body_secondary != blank %}
        <div class="our-approach__body">
          {% if s.body_primary != blank %}<div class="our-approach__paragraph our-approach__paragraph--primary">{{ s.body_primary }}</div>{% endif %}
          {% if s.body_secondary != blank %}<div class="our-approach__paragraph our-approach__paragraph--secondary">{{ s.body_secondary }}</div>{% endif %}
        </div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if desktop_image != blank %}
      <div class="our-approach__media" {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal{% endif %}>
        <picture class="our-approach__picture">
          {% if mobile_image != desktop_image %}
            <source media="(max-width: 749px)" srcset="{{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 375 }} 375w, {{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 750 }} 750w, {{ mobile_image | image_url: width: 1100 }} 1100w" sizes="calc(100vw - 40px)" width="{{ mobile_image.width }}" height="{{ mobile_image.height }}">
          {% endif %}
          {{ desktop_image | image_url: width: 2200 | image_tag: class: 'our-approach__image', widths: '375,550,750,1100,1500,1800,2200', sizes: '(min-width: 1440px) 587px, (min-width: 990px) 40.77vw, (min-width: 750px) calc(100vw - 64px), calc(100vw - 40px)', loading: image_loading, fetchpriority: image_priority, decoding: 'async', alt: image_alt }}
        </picture>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</scroll-reveal-component>
{% stylesheet %}
  .our-approach__background { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: var(--layer-section-background, -1); pointer-events: none; }
  .our-approach { overflow: clip; color: var(--our-approach-text, #000); font-family: var(--our-approach-font, var(--font-heading--family)); }
  .our-approach__inner { width: 100%; max-width: 1440px; margin-inline: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 729fr) minmax(0, 587fr); padding-inline: min(4.30556vw, 62px); align-items: start; min-width: 0; }
  .our-approach__copy { min-width: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .our-approach__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 clamp(10px, 1.04167vw, 15px); font-size: clamp(18px, 1.66667vw, 24px); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.583333; }
  .our-approach__heading { margin: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: clamp(40px, 4.02778vw, 58px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.034483; letter-spacing: normal; color: var(--our-approach-text, #000); background: var(--our-approach-gradient); background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .our-approach__body { margin-block-start: clamp(36px, 4.16667vw, 60px); display: grid; gap: 20px; font-size: clamp(18px, 1.66667vw, 24px); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.583333; }
  .our-approach__paragraph { width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .our-approach__paragraph--primary { max-width: 77.7742%; }
  .our-approach__paragraph--secondary { max-width: 75.6929%; }
  .our-approach__paragraph > :first-child { margin-block-start: 0; }
  .our-approach__paragraph > :last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }
  .our-approach__paragraph a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
  .our-approach__paragraph a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; }
  .our-approach__media { min-width: 0; }
  .our-approach__picture { display: block; }
  .our-approach__image { display: block; width: auto; height: auto; max-width: 100%; -webkit-user-drag: none; user-select: none; }
  .our-approach--text-only .our-approach__inner { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); inset-inline-start: 0; padding-inline: min(4.30556vw, 62px); }
  .our-approach--text-only .our-approach__copy { max-width: 900px; }
  .our-approach--text-only .our-approach__paragraph { max-width: 729px; }
  .our-approach.reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='before'] { transform: translateY(24px); }
  @media screen and (max-width: 989px) {
    .our-approach__inner, .our-approach--text-only .our-approach__inner { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); inset-inline-start: 0; padding-inline: 32px; gap: 40px; }
    .our-approach__heading { font-size: clamp(40px, 5.8vw, 48px); line-height: 1.15; }
    .our-approach__heading br { display: none; }
    .our-approach__body { margin-block-start: 28px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .our-approach__paragraph--primary, .our-approach__paragraph--secondary { max-width: 100%; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .our-approach { padding-block: var(--our-approach-mobile-top, 40px) var(--our-approach-mobile-bottom, 40px); }
    .our-approach__inner, .our-approach--text-only .our-approach__inner { padding-inline: 20px; gap: 32px; }
    .our-approach__eyebrow { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin-block-end: 12px; }
    .our-approach__heading { font-size: clamp(32px, 8.20513vw, 36px); line-height: 1.15; }
    .our-approach__body { margin-block-start: 24px; gap: 20px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.611111; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .our-approach.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/our-work.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Our work.
  Renders a left-aligned label, a gradient headline, and supporting copy above a
  horizontal, scroll-snapped row of merchant-managed result cards.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Our work" section, then edit each result card block -->
{% endcomment %}

<script
  src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}"
  type="module"
  fetchpriority="low"
></script>

{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
%}



<div
  class="section-background our-work__background"
  style="
    --work-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
    --work-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --work-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
  "
></div>

<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--page-width our-work spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --work-heading-font-family: {{ section_settings.font }};
    --work-heading-font-size: {{ section_settings.font_size }};
    --work-heading-font-weight: {{ section_settings.weight }};
    --work-heading-line-height: {{ section_settings.line_height | default: '1' }};
    --text-wrap: {{ section_settings.wrap | default: 'balance' }};
    --work-heading-gap: {{ section_settings.heading_gap }}px;
    --work-card-width: {{ section_settings.card_width }}px;
    --work-card-height: {{ section_settings.card_height }}px;
    --work-card-gap: {{ section_settings.card_gap }}px;
    --work-card-radius: {{ section_settings.card_radius }}px;
    --work-card-media-radius: {{ section_settings.card_media_radius }}px;
    --work-card-background: {{ section_settings.card_background }};
    --work-card-padding-block-start: {{ section_settings.card_padding_block_start }}px;
    --work-card-padding-block-end: {{ section_settings.card_padding_block_end }}px;
    --work-card-padding-inline-start: {{ section_settings.card_padding_inline_start }}px;
    --work-card-padding-inline-end: {{ section_settings.card_padding_inline_end }}px;
    --work-tag-background: {{ section_settings.tag_background }};
    --work-tag-border: {{ section_settings.tag_border }};
    --work-tag-color: {{ section_settings.tag_color }};
    --work-description-color: {{ section_settings.description_color }};
    --work-metric-color: {{ section_settings.metric_color }};
    --work-metric-label-color: {{ section_settings.metric_label_color }};
    --work-content-width: 1280px;
  "
  data-reveal-scope
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank or heading_text != blank or section_settings.description != blank %}
    <div class="our-work__intro" data-reveal>
      {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank %}
        <p class="our-work__eyebrow">{{ section_settings.eyebrow }}</p>
      {% endif %}

      {% if heading_text != blank %}
        {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
        <div
          class="
            our-work__heading
            text-block
            text-block--full-width
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
          "
          style="
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
              --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
              --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
              --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
              --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
              --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
            {% endif %}
          "
        >
          {{ heading_text }}
        </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="our-work__description">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {%- capture result_cards -%}
    {% content_for 'blocks' %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if result_cards != blank %}
    <div class="our-work__track force-full-width">{{ result_cards }}</div>
  {% endif %}
</scroll-reveal-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .our-work__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--work-bg-angle, 104deg),
      var(--work-bg-from, #aac5ff) 2.81%,
      var(--work-bg-to, #cbd5fd) 97.19%
    );
  }

  .our-work__intro {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--work-content-width, 1280px);
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  .our-work__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 38px;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .our-work__heading {
    font-family: var(--work-heading-font-family, var(--font-heading--family));
    font-size: var(--work-heading-font-size, 3.625rem);
    font-weight: var(--work-heading-font-weight, 600);
    line-height: var(--work-heading-line-height, 1);
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .our-work__description {
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .our-work__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .our-work__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  .our-work__track {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--work-card-gap, 40px);
    width: 100%;
    margin-block-start: var(--work-heading-gap, 40px);
    padding-inline: max(var(--page-margin), calc((100% - var(--work-content-width, 1280px)) / 2));
    overflow-x: auto;
    /* Keep vertical gestures on the page, including while cards reveal. */
    overflow-y: hidden;
    overscroll-behavior: auto;
    touch-action: pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom;
    scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
    scroll-padding-inline-start: max(var(--page-margin), calc((100% - var(--work-content-width, 1280px)) / 2));
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .our-work__track::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .our-work__track > * {
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }

  .our-work__track > .result-card {
    /* Zoom scales media, type and spacing together and reduces layout size. */
    zoom: 0.85;
  }

  .our-work.reveal-ready .our-work__track > .result-card[data-reveal] {
    /* Fade cards without extending the track's vertical scroll bounds. */
    transform: none;
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .our-work__eyebrow {
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .our-work__heading {
      font-size: 2.25rem;
    }

    .our-work__description {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .our-work__track {
      gap: 16px;
      margin-block-start: 24px;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/page-background.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Page background.
  Sets a solid or gradient page background for the template it is added to.
  Add it to any page/template (each page can use its own template) to give that
  page a distinct background without changing the global theme setting.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Page background" section to a template, then pick a color or gradient -->
{% endcomment %}

{% liquid
  assign background_type = section.settings.background_type
  assign background_color = section.settings.background_color
  assign gradient_from = section.settings.gradient_color_from
  assign gradient_to = section.settings.gradient_color_to
  assign gradient_angle = section.settings.gradient_angle
%}

{% if background_type == 'gradient' or background_color != blank %}
  <span class="page-background__active" hidden></span>
  {% style %}
    body {
      {% if background_type == 'gradient' %}
        --color-background: {{ gradient_from }};
        --color-background-rgb: {{ gradient_from.rgb }};
        --page-background-image: linear-gradient({{ gradient_angle }}deg, {{ gradient_from }} 0%, {{ gradient_to }} 100%);
        --page-background-section-fill: transparent;
      {% else %}
        --color-background: {{ background_color }};
        --color-background-rgb: {{ background_color.rgb }};
        --page-background-image: none;
        --page-background-section-fill: {{ background_color }};
      {% endif %}
    }
  {% endstyle %}
{% endif %}
{% stylesheet %}
  body:has(.page-background__active) {
    background-color: var(--color-background);
    background-image: var(--page-background-image, none);
    background-attachment: fixed;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
  }
  .shopify-section:not(.header-section) .section-background {
    background-color: var(--page-background-section-fill, var(--color-background));
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    body:has(.page-background__active) { background-attachment: scroll; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
{
  "name": "t:names.page_background",
  "class": "page-background",
  "disabled_on": {
    "groups": ["header", "footer"]
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "paragraph",
      "content": "t:content.page_background_hint"
    },
    {
      "type": "select",
      "id": "background_type",
      "label": "t:settings.style",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "solid",
          "label": "t:options.solid"
        },
        {
          "value": "gradient",
          "label": "t:options.gradient"
        }
      ],
      "default": "solid"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "background_color",
      "label": "t:settings.background_color",
      "alpha": true,
      "default": "#FFFFFF",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.background_type == 'solid' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "gradient_color_from",
      "label": "t:settings.gradient_color_from",
      "default": "#AAC5FF",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.background_type == 'gradient' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "color",
      "id": "gradient_color_to",
      "label": "t:settings.gradient_color_to",
      "default": "#CBD5FD",
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.background_type == 'gradient' }}"
    },
    {
      "type": "range",
      "id": "gradient_angle",
      "label": "t:settings.gradient_angle",
      "min": 0,
      "max": 360,
      "step": 4,
      "unit": "deg",
      "default": 180,
      "visible_if": "{{ section.settings.background_type == 'gradient' }}"
    }
  ],
  "presets": [
    {
      "name": "t:names.page_background",
      "category": "t:categories.layout"
    }
  ]
}
{% endschema %}
````

## sections/partner-brands.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Partner brand showcase.
  Renders an optional gradient heading, a divider, and a wrapping row of
  merchant-managed logo blocks centered on a full-bleed gradient background.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Partner brands" section, then drop a logo image into each logo block -->
{% endcomment %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
%}



<div
  class="section-background partner-brands__background"
  style="
    --brand-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --brand-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
    --brand-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
  "
></div>

<div
  class="section section--page-width partner-brands spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --brand-logo-gap: {{ section_settings.logo_gap }}px;
    --brand-logo-row-gap: {{ section_settings.row_gap }}px;
    --brand-logo-height: {{ section_settings.logo_height }}px;
  "
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if heading_text != blank %}
    {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
    <div
      class="
        partner-brands__heading
        text-block
        text-block--full-width
        custom-typography
        custom-font-size
        {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
      "
      style="
        {% render 'typography-style', settings: section_settings, type: 'body', preset: 'custom' %}
        --text-align: {{ section_settings.alignment }};
        {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
          --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
          --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
          --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
          --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
          --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
        {% endif %}
      "
    >
      {{ heading_text }}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {% if section_settings.thickness > 0 %}
 
  {% endif %}

  {%- capture logos -%}
    {% content_for 'blocks' %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if logos != blank %}
    <div class="partner-brands__logos">{{ logos }}</div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .partner-brands__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--brand-bg-angle, 105deg),
      var(--brand-bg-from, #aac5ff) 2.81%,
      var(--brand-bg-to, #cbd5fd) 97.19%
    );
  }

  .partner-brands__heading {
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    margin-block-end: 32px;
  }

  /* Full-bleed divider: `force-full-width` spans the section's outer grid columns. */
  .partner-brands__divider {
    width: var(--brand-divider-width, 100%);
    max-width: 100%;
    justify-self: center;
    border-block-start: var(--brand-divider-thickness, 0.5px) solid var(--brand-divider-color, #707070);
    margin-block-end: 40px;
  }

  /* Each row is a `_brand-row` block stacked vertically; the row owns its own
     horizontal layout, so rows can hold different numbers of logos. */
  .partner-brands__logos {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    gap: var(--brand-logo-row-gap, 16px);
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .partner-brands__divider {
      margin-block-end: 24px;
    }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .partner-brands .brand-row { --brand-logo-gap: 24px; --brand-logo-height: 28px; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}

{% schema %}
````

## sections/product-hero.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Product hero for service pages. Header-free, centered copy with up to two
  editable theme buttons. One button centers; two buttons sit side by side.
  @example Add Product hero, edit the copy, and keep one or two button blocks.
{% endcomment %}

{% render 'text-block-styles' %}
{% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}
<script src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>



<div class="section-background product-hero__background" style="--product-hero-bg-from:{{ section.settings.background_from }};--product-hero-bg-to:{{ section.settings.background_to }};"></div>
<scroll-reveal-component class="section section--full-width section--height-{{ section.settings.section_height | default: 'large' }} spacing-style product-hero" data-reveal-scope data-reveal-timeline style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section.settings %}--product-hero-description-color:{{ section.settings.description_color }};">
  <div class="product-hero__content">
    {% if section.settings.eyebrow != blank %}
      <p class="product-hero__eyebrow" data-reveal>{{ section.settings.eyebrow | escape }}</p>
    {% endif %}
    {% if section.settings.heading != blank %}
      <{{ section.settings.heading_tag }}
        class="product-hero__heading text-block text-block--gradient"
        data-reveal
        style="--gradient-from:{{ section.settings.heading_from }};--gradient-to:{{ section.settings.heading_to }};--gradient-angle:96.71deg;--gradient-start:11.696%;--gradient-end:88.304%;"
      >{{ section.settings.heading | escape | newline_to_br }}</{{ section.settings.heading_tag }}>
    {% endif %}
    {% if section.settings.description != blank %}
      <p class="product-hero__description" data-reveal>{{ section.settings.description | escape | newline_to_br }}</p>
    {% endif %}
    {% capture actions %}{% content_for 'blocks' %}{% endcapture %}
    {% if actions != blank %}
      <div class="product-hero__actions" data-reveal>{{ actions }}</div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</scroll-reveal-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .product-hero {
    align-items: center;
  }
  .product-hero__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(92.19deg, var(--product-hero-bg-from) 1.07%, var(--product-hero-bg-to) 98.93%);
  }
  .product-hero__content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 40px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1440px;
    min-width: 0;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: max(var(--page-margin), 24px);
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .product-hero__eyebrow {
    max-width: 1042px;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(20px, 1.94445vw, 28px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.22;
    color: #000;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .product-hero__heading {
    max-width: 1042px;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 4.86112vw, 70px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2143;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .product-hero__description {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1152px;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 1.94445vw, 28px);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.22;
    color: var(--product-hero-description-color);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .product-hero__actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 40px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1096px;
  }
  .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom) {
    flex: 0 1 528px;
    width: 528px;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 72px;
    padding: 17px 28px;
    line-height: 38px;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    transition:
      transform var(--animation-speed) var(--animation-easing),
      opacity var(--animation-speed) var(--animation-easing);
  }
  /* Override the same variables that the theme changes on hover. Base values
     come from each button's own renderer, including dynamically nested blocks. */
  .product-hero .product-hero__actions .button-custom:hover {
    --button-color: var(--button-rest-color);
    --button-background-color: var(--button-rest-background);
    --button-border-color: var(--button-rest-border);
    color: var(--button-color);
    -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
    background-color: var(--button-background-color);
    opacity: 0.9;
  }
  .product-hero .product-hero__actions [data-button-gradient='true']:hover {
    --button-color: #fff;
    color: #fff;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #fff;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .product-hero.reveal-ready [data-reveal] {
    transition: none;
  }
  .product-hero.reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='in'] {
    animation: product-hero-fade-up 700ms ease-in both;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--reveal-index, 0) * 120ms);
  }
  @keyframes product-hero-fade-up {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom):not([aria-disabled='true']):hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 var(--button-border-width) var(--button-border-color),
        0 6px 18px rgb(12 35 184 / 12%);
    }
    .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom):not([aria-disabled='true']):active {
      transform: translateY(0);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--button-border-width) var(--button-border-color);
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .product-hero.reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='in'] {
      animation: none;
    }
    .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom),
    .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom):not([aria-disabled='true']):is(:hover, :active) {
      transition: none;
      transform: none;
    }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .product-hero__content { gap: 24px; }
    .product-hero__heading { font-size: clamp(32px, 6vw, 44px); }
    .product-hero__description { line-height: 1.5; }
    .product-hero__description br { display: none; }
    .product-hero__actions { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
    .product-hero__actions > :is(.button, .button-secondary, .button-custom) {
      flex: none;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 60px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/service-scope.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Service scope: editable introduction and a responsive list of service modules.
  Empty background shows the page background; card transparency is independent.
  @example Add "Service scope" and edit, add or reorder its service cards.
{% endcomment %}
{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
  assign card_alpha = s.card_opacity | divided_by: 100.0
  assign card_count = 0
  for block in section.blocks limit: 50
    if block.settings.heading != blank or block.settings.description != blank or request.design_mode
      assign card_count = card_count | plus: 1
    endif
  endfor
%}
{% render 'custom-section-fonts', font: s.font %}
{% if s.enable_reveal %}
  {% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}
  <script src="{{ 'scroll-reveal.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>
{% endif %}
<div class="service-scope__background" style="background: {{ s.background | default: 'transparent' }};" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<scroll-reveal-component
  class="section section--full-width spacing-style service-scope{% if request.design_mode %} service-scope--editor{% endif %}"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: s %}
    --service-scope-font: {{ s.font.family | escape }}, {{ s.font.fallback_families }};
    --service-scope-text: {{ s.text_color }};
    --service-scope-gradient: {{ s.heading_gradient | default: s.text_color }};
    --service-scope-card-background: {{ s.card_background | color_modify: 'alpha', card_alpha }};
    --service-scope-card-border: {{ s.card_border }};
    --service-scope-card-radius: {{ s.card_radius }}px;
    --service-scope-column-gap: {{ s.column_gap }}px;
    --service-scope-row-gap: {{ s.row_gap }}px;
    --service-scope-mobile-top: {{ s.padding_mobile_top }}px;
    --service-scope-mobile-bottom: {{ s.padding_mobile_bottom }}px;"
  {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal-scope{% endif %}
>
  <div class="service-scope__inner">
    {% if s.eyebrow != blank or s.heading != blank or s.description != blank %}
      <div class="service-scope__intro" {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal{% endif %}>
        {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="service-scope__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
        {% if s.heading != blank %}<h2 class="service-scope__heading">{{ s.heading | escape }}</h2>{% endif %}
        {% if s.description != blank %}<div class="service-scope__description">{{ s.description }}</div>{% endif %}
      </div>
    {% endif %}
    {% if card_count > 0 %}
      <ul class="service-scope__grid" role="list">
        {% for block in section.blocks limit: 50 %}
          {% if block.settings.heading != blank or block.settings.description != blank or request.design_mode %}
            <li class="service-scope__card" {% if s.enable_reveal %}data-reveal{% endif %} {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
              {% if block.settings.heading != blank %}<h3 class="service-scope__card-heading">{{ block.settings.heading | escape }}</h3>{% endif %}
              {% if block.settings.description != blank %}<div class="service-scope__card-description">{{ block.settings.description }}</div>{% endif %}
            </li>
          {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
      </ul>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</scroll-reveal-component>
{% stylesheet %}
  .service-scope__background {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: var(--layer-section-background, -1);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .service-scope {
    color: var(--service-scope-text, #000);
    font-family: var(--service-scope-font, var(--font-heading--family));
  }
  .service-scope__inner {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1440px;
    min-width: 0;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: min(4.30556vw, 62px);
  }
  .service-scope__intro { display: grid; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
  .service-scope__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 1.66667vw, 24px);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.583333;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .service-scope__heading {
    max-width: 1306px;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: clamp(40px, 4.02778vw, 58px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.224138;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    color: inherit;
    background: var(--service-scope-gradient, #0b22b8);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .service-scope__description {
    max-width: 1098.617px;
    font-size: clamp(20px, 1.66667vw, 24px);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.583333;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .service-scope__description > :first-child,
  .service-scope__card-description > :first-child { margin-block-start: 0; }
  .service-scope__description > :last-child,
  .service-scope__card-description > :last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }
  .service-scope__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--service-scope-row-gap, 29px) var(--service-scope-column-gap, 33px);
    width: calc(100% - min(3.05556vw, 44px));
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .service-scope__intro + .service-scope__grid { margin-block-start: 40px; }
  .service-scope__card {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 176px;
    padding: 31px 8px 32px 20px;
    padding-inline: 20px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--service-scope-card-border, #fff);
    border-radius: var(--service-scope-card-radius, 13px);
    background: var(--service-scope-card-background, #ffffff94);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .service-scope__card-heading {
    margin: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: clamp(22px, 1.73611vw, 25px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: normal;
  }
  .service-scope__card-description { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; }
  .service-scope__card-heading + .service-scope__card-description { margin-block-start: 20px; }
  .service-scope__description a,
  .service-scope__card-description a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
  .service-scope a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; }
  .service-scope.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { transition-delay: min(calc(var(--reveal-index, 0) * 60ms), 240ms); }
  .service-scope.reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='before'] { transform: translateY(24px); }
  .service-scope--editor.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
  @media screen and (max-width: 989px) {
    .service-scope__inner { padding-inline: 32px; }
    .service-scope__heading { font-size: clamp(40px, 5.8vw, 48px); line-height: 1.2; }
    .service-scope__description { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .service-scope__grid { width: 100%; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px; }
    .service-scope__card { padding: 24px; }
    .service-scope__card-heading { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.3; }
    .service-scope__card-description { line-height: 1.5; }
    .service-scope__description br { display: none; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .service-scope { padding-block: var(--service-scope-mobile-top, 40px) var(--service-scope-mobile-bottom, 40px); }
    .service-scope__inner { padding-inline: 20px; }
    .service-scope__intro { gap: 12px; }
    .service-scope__eyebrow { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .service-scope__heading { font-size: clamp(32px, 8.20513vw, 36px); line-height: 1.15; }
    .service-scope__description { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.611111; }
    .service-scope__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
    .service-scope__intro + .service-scope__grid { margin-block-start: 32px; }
    .service-scope__card { min-height: 0; }
    .service-scope__card-heading { font-size: 22px; }
    .service-scope__card-heading + .service-scope__card-description { margin-block-start: 16px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .service-scope.reveal-ready [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .service-scope__heading { color: CanvasText; background: none; -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor; }
    .service-scope__card { border-color: CanvasText; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/services-globe.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Services globe. Editable service overview with a decorative COBE globe.
  @example
  <!-- Add Services globe between Partner brands and the solutions grid. -->
{% endcomment %}

{% liquid
  assign s = section.settings
  assign color_id = 'services-' | append: section.id
  assign service_keys = 'web_commerce,customer_growth,ai_technology,partner_marketing,data_intelligence' | split: ','
%}
{% render 'contrast-override', background_color: s.background_gradient_from, text_color: s.text_color, section_id: color_id, preset: 'content' %}
{% render 'text-block-styles' %}
<script src="{{ 'services-globe.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>

<div
  class="services-globe color-custom-{{ color_id }}"
  style="
    --services-bg-from: {{ s.background_gradient_from }};
    --services-bg-to: {{ s.background_gradient_to }};
    --services-font: {{ s.font }};
    --services-heading-size: {{ s.font_size }};
    --services-link-color: {{ s.link_color }};
    --gradient-from: {{ s.gradient_color_from }};
    --gradient-to: {{ s.gradient_color_to }};
    --gradient-angle: 110.486deg;
    --gradient-start: 11.742%;
    --gradient-end: 88.258%;
  "
>
  <div class="services-globe__layout">
    <div class="services-globe__intro">
      <div class="services-globe__title">
        {% if s.eyebrow != blank %}<p class="services-globe__eyebrow">{{ s.eyebrow | escape }}</p>{% endif %}
        {% if s.heading != blank %}
          <h2 class="services-globe__heading text-block{% if s.gradient_text %} text-block--gradient{% endif %}">{{ s.heading | escape | newline_to_br }}</h2>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      <div class="services-globe__copy">
        {% if s.description != blank %}<div class="services-globe__description">{{ s.description }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if s.link_label != blank and s.link != blank %}
          <a class="services-globe__link" href="{{ s.link | escape }}">{{ s.link_label | escape }}</a>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="services-globe__visual">
      <div class="services-globe__art" aria-hidden="true">
        <img class="services-globe__glow" src="{{ 'services-globe-glow.svg' | asset_url }}" width="1097" height="688" alt="" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
        <img class="services-globe__orbit" src="{{ 'services-globe-orbit.png' | asset_url }}" width="1245" height="1003" alt="" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
        <services-globe-component class="services-globe__renderer" data-rotate="{{ s.auto_rotate }}">
          <img ref="fallback" class="services-globe__fallback" src="{{ 'services-globe-fallback.png' | asset_url }}" width="1148" height="1148" alt="" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
          <div ref="host" class="services-globe__canvas-host"><canvas ref="canvas" class="services-globe__canvas" width="1148" height="1148"></canvas></div>
        </services-globe-component>
      </div>
      <ul class="services-globe__services" role="list">
        {% for key in service_keys limit: 5 %}
          {% if s[key] != blank %}<li class="services-globe__service services-globe__service--{{ key }}">{{ s[key] | escape }}</li>{% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .services-globe {
    overflow: clip;
    background-image: linear-gradient(123.856deg, var(--services-bg-from) 27.224%, var(--services-bg-to) 99.351%);
    font-family: var(--services-font, var(--font-heading--family));
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }
  .services-globe__layout { container-type: inline-size; max-inline-size: 1440px; margin-inline: auto; }
  .services-globe__intro {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 513fr) minmax(0, 513fr);
    gap: 17.083cqw;
    padding-block-start: 4.375cqw;
    padding-inline: 5.833cqw;
  }
  .services-globe__title, .services-globe__copy { min-inline-size: 0; }
  .services-globe__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 0.694cqw; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.667cqw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.583; }
  .services-globe__heading {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: min(var(--services-heading-size), 4.028cqw);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.224;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    text-wrap: pretty;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }
  .services-globe__copy { padding-block-start: 3.333cqw; }
  .services-globe__description { font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.667cqw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.583; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .services-globe__description > :first-child { margin-block-start: 0; }
  .services-globe__description > :last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }
  .services-globe__link { display: inline-block; margin-block-start: 1.944cqw; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.597cqw, 1.4375rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.217; color: var(--services-link-color); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
  .services-globe__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }
  .services-globe__visual { position: relative; block-size: 36.042cqw; margin-block-start: 9.097cqw; }
  .services-globe__art { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .services-globe__glow { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 12.917cqw; inset-inline-start: 12.292%; inline-size: 76.181%; block-size: auto; max-inline-size: none; opacity: 0.6; }
  .services-globe__orbit { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 2.955cqw; inset-inline-start: 6.215%; inline-size: 86.456%; max-inline-size: none; block-size: auto; }
  .services-globe__renderer { display: block; position: absolute; inset-block-start: -10.069cqw; inset-inline-start: 10.139%; inline-size: 79.722%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
  .services-globe__fallback { display: block; inline-size: 100%; block-size: auto; }
  /* Keep the globe's upper edge aligned when reducing its COBE scale. */
  .services-globe__canvas-host { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 22.5%; inset-inline: 0; inline-size: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
  .services-globe__canvas { display: block; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; opacity: 0; filter: sepia(1) saturate(10) hue-rotate(185deg) brightness(1.5); }
  .services-globe__renderer[data-ready] .services-globe__fallback { visibility: hidden; }
  .services-globe__renderer[data-ready] .services-globe__canvas { opacity: 1; }
  .services-globe__services { position: relative; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .services-globe__service { position: absolute; max-inline-size: 24%; translate: -50% 0; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.806cqw, 1.625rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.231; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .services-globe__service--web_commerce { inset-inline-start: 17.222%; inset-block-start: 13.958cqw; }
  .services-globe__service--customer_growth { inset-inline-start: 31.84%; inset-block-start: 5cqw; }
  .services-globe__service--ai_technology { inset-inline-start: 50.417%; inset-block-start: 0; }
  .services-globe__service--partner_marketing { inset-inline-start: 69.132%; inset-block-start: 5cqw; }
  .services-globe__service--data_intelligence { inset-inline-start: 83.958%; inset-block-start: 14.583cqw; }
  [dir='rtl'] .services-globe__service { translate: 50% 0; }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .services-globe__intro { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; padding: 40px 24px 0; }
    .services-globe__heading { font-size: min(var(--services-heading-size), 2.5rem); }
    .services-globe__copy { padding-block-start: 0; }
    .services-globe__link { min-block-size: 44px; margin-block-start: 16px; }
    .services-globe__visual { display: flex; flex-direction: column; block-size: auto; margin-block-start: 32px; }
    .services-globe__services { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px 16px; padding-inline: 24px; }
    .services-globe__service { position: static; max-inline-size: none; translate: none; font-size: 1rem; }
    .services-globe__service:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    .services-globe__art { position: relative; order: 1; block-size: 55cqw; margin-block-start: 24px; }
    .services-globe__renderer { inset-block-start: -27.7cqw; inset-inline-start: 0; inline-size: 100%; }
    .services-globe__orbit { inset-block-start: 0; }
    [dir='rtl'] .services-globe__service { translate: none; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## sections/why-choose-us.liquid

````liquid
{% comment %}
  Why choose us.
  Renders an optional eyebrow, a gradient headline, and supporting copy above a
  row of merchant-managed value-proposition blocks, all on a full-bleed gradient
  background.
  @example
  <!-- Add the "Why choose us" section, then edit each feature block -->
{% endcomment %}

{% liquid
  assign section_settings = section.settings
  assign heading_text = section_settings.heading
%}



<div
  class="section-background why-choose-us__background"
  style="
    --wcu-bg-angle: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_angle }}deg;
    --wcu-bg-from: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_from }};
    --wcu-bg-to: {{ section_settings.background_gradient_to }};
  "
></div>

<div
  class="section section--page-width why-choose-us spacing-style"
  style="{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section_settings %}
    --wcu-heading-gap: {{ section_settings.heading_gap }}px;
    --wcu-column-gap: {{ section_settings.column_gap }}px;
    --wcu-row-gap: {{ section_settings.row_gap }}px;
  "
  {{ section.shopify_attributes }}
>
  {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank or heading_text != blank or section_settings.description != blank %}
    <div class="why-choose-us__intro">
      {% if section_settings.eyebrow != blank %}
        <p class="why-choose-us__eyebrow">{{ section_settings.eyebrow }}</p>
      {% endif %}

      {% if heading_text != blank %}
        {% render 'text-block-styles' %}
        <div
          class="
            why-choose-us__heading
            text-block
            text-block--full-width
            custom-typography
            custom-font-size
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}text-block--gradient{% endif %}
          "
          style="
            {% render 'typography-style', settings: section_settings, type: 'heading', preset: 'custom' %}
            --text-align: {{ section_settings.alignment }};
            {% if section_settings.gradient_text %}
              --gradient-from: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_from }};
              --gradient-to: {{ section_settings.gradient_color_to }};
              --gradient-angle: {{ section_settings.gradient_angle }}deg;
              --gradient-start: {{ section_settings.gradient_start_position }}%;
              --gradient-end: {{ section_settings.gradient_end_position }}%;
            {% endif %}
          "
        >
          {{ heading_text }}
        </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if section_settings.description != blank %}
        <div class="why-choose-us__description">{{ section_settings.description }}</div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  {%- capture value_props -%}
    {% content_for 'blocks' %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {% if value_props != blank %}
    <div class="why-choose-us__grid">{{ value_props }}</div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .why-choose-us__background {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      var(--wcu-bg-angle, 180deg),
      var(--wcu-bg-from, #aac5ff) 0%,
      var(--wcu-bg-to, #c9d5fd) 100%
    );
  }

  .why-choose-us__intro {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .why-choose-us__eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-heading--family);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .why-choose-us__heading {
    color: var(--color-foreground);
  }

  .why-choose-us__description {
    font-family: Montserrat;
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .why-choose-us__description > :first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }

  .why-choose-us__description > :last-child {
    margin-block-end: 0;
  }

  .why-choose-us__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--wcu-row-gap, 40px) var(--wcu-column-gap, 28px);
    width: 100%;
    margin-block-start: var(--wcu-heading-gap, 64px);
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 750px) {
    .why-choose-us__grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 990px) {
    .why-choose-us__grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .why-choose-us__eyebrow {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
    }

    .why-choose-us__description {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
    }

    .why-choose-us__grid {
      --wcu-row-gap: 32px;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## snippets/custom-client-story-placeholder.liquid

````liquid
{% doc %}
  Original decorative case-study placeholder, loaded only when no client image exists.
  @example {% render 'custom-client-story-placeholder' %}
{% enddoc %}
        <div class="client-story__placeholder">
          <span class="client-story__corner client-story__corner--start-top" aria-hidden="true"><img src="{{ 'client-story-corner-left.svg' | asset_url }}" width="40" height="35.5" alt="" loading="lazy"></span>
          <span class="client-story__corner client-story__corner--start-bottom" aria-hidden="true"><img src="{{ 'client-story-corner-left.svg' | asset_url }}" width="40" height="35.5" alt="" loading="lazy"></span>
          <span class="client-story__corner client-story__corner--end-top" aria-hidden="true"><img src="{{ 'client-story-corner-right.svg' | asset_url }}" width="40" height="35.5" alt="" loading="lazy"></span>
          <span class="client-story__corner client-story__corner--end-bottom" aria-hidden="true"><img src="{{ 'client-story-corner-right.svg' | asset_url }}" width="40" height="35.5" alt="" loading="lazy"></span>
          <div class="client-story__placeholder-copy">
            <img class="client-story__placeholder-icon" src="{{ 'client-story-image.svg' | asset_url }}" width="80.0568" height="84.2463" alt="" loading="lazy">
            <p class="client-story__placeholder-title">{{ 'client_story.image_title' | t }}</p>
            <p class="client-story__placeholder-description">{{ 'client_story.image_description' | t }}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

{% stylesheet %}
  .client-story__placeholder { position: absolute; inset: 0; container-type: inline-size; }
  .client-story__corner { position: absolute; }
  .client-story__corner img { display: block; inline-size: auto; block-size: auto; max-inline-size: none; }
  .client-story__corner--start-top { inset-inline-start: 11.61%; inset-block-start: 5.63%; }
  .client-story__corner--start-bottom { inset-inline-start: 11.61%; inset-block-end: 5.63%; transform: scaleY(-1); }
  .client-story__corner--end-top { inset-inline-end: 11.61%; inset-block-start: 5.63%; transform: scaleX(-1); }
  .client-story__corner--end-bottom { inset-inline-end: 11.61%; inset-block-end: 5.63%; transform: rotate(180deg); }
  .client-story__placeholder-copy { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 36.32%; inset-inline: 8%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
  .client-story__placeholder-icon { display: block; flex: none; inline-size: auto; block-size: auto; max-inline-size: none; }
  .client-story__placeholder-title { margin: 0; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 30px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .client-story__placeholder-copy > .client-story__placeholder-title { margin-block-start: 25px; }
  .client-story__placeholder-description { max-inline-size: 454px; margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  [dir='rtl'] .client-story__corner img { transform: scaleX(-1); }
  @media screen and (min-width: 990px) and (max-width: 1439px) {
.client-story__placeholder-title { font-size: 22px; }
  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
.client-story__placeholder-copy { inset-block-start: 24%; }
  .client-story__placeholder-title { font-size: 18px; line-height: 24px; }
  .client-story__placeholder-copy > .client-story__placeholder-title { margin-block-start: 16px; }
  .client-story__placeholder-description { font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## snippets/custom-footer-diagnosis-form.liquid

````liquid
{% doc %}
  Native contact form and its scoped progressive enhancement for the diagnosis footer.
  @param {object} section_settings - Merchant-authored labels and placeholders.
  @param {string} form_id - Unique contact-form ID.
  @param {string} form_anchor_id - Optional merchant-configured anchor.
  @example {% render 'custom-footer-diagnosis-form', section_settings: section.settings, form_id: form_id, form_anchor_id: form_anchor_id %}
{% enddoc %}
    <footer-diagnosis
      class="footer-diagnosis__card"
      {% if form_anchor_id != blank and form_anchor_id != form_id %}id="{{ form_anchor_id | escape }}" tabindex="-1"{% endif %}
    >
      {%- form 'contact', id: form_id, class: 'footer-diagnosis__form' -%}
        <input type="hidden" name="contact[id]" value="{{ form_id }}">

        {%- if form.errors and form.id == form_id -%}
          <div class="footer-diagnosis__error" role="alert" tabindex="-1" autofocus>
            {{- 'icon-error.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}
            <div>
              {%- for field in form.errors -%}
                <p>
                  {{- form.errors.translated_fields[field] | capitalize }}
                  {{ form.errors.messages[field] -}}
                </p>
              {%- endfor -%}
            </div>
          </div>
        {%- endif -%}

        {%- if form.posted_successfully? and form.id == form_id -%}
          <div class="footer-diagnosis__success" role="status" tabindex="-1" autofocus>
            {{- 'icon-checkmark.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}
            <span>{{ 'blocks.contact_form.post_success' | t }}</span>
          </div>
        {%- endif -%}

        <div class="footer-diagnosis__fields">
          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-name">
              {{ section_settings.name_label }}
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="{{ form_id }}-name"
              name="contact[name]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input"
              autocomplete="name"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.name_placeholder | escape }}"
              value="{% if form.name %}{{ form.name | escape }}{% elsif customer %}{{ customer.name | escape }}{% endif %}"
              required
            >
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-company">
              {{ section_settings.company_label }}
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="{{ form_id }}-company"
              name="contact[Company Name]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input"
              autocomplete="organization"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.company_placeholder | escape }}"
            >
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-email">
              {{ section_settings.email_label }}
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              id="{{ form_id }}-email"
              name="contact[email]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input"
              autocomplete="email"
              spellcheck="false"
              autocapitalize="off"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.email_placeholder | escape }}"
              value="{% if form.email %}{{ form.email | escape }}{% elsif customer %}{{ customer.email | escape }}{% endif %}"
              required
            >
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-phone">
              {{ section_settings.phone_label }}
            </label>
            <input
              type="tel"
              id="{{ form_id }}-phone"
              name="contact[phone]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input"
              autocomplete="tel"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.phone_placeholder | escape }}"
              value="{% if form.phone %}{{ form.phone | escape }}{% elsif customer %}{{ customer.phone | escape }}{% endif %}"
            >
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field footer-diagnosis__field--full">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-website">
              {{ section_settings.website_label }}
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="url"
              id="{{ form_id }}-website"
              name="contact[Company Website]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input"
              autocomplete="url"
              inputmode="url"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.website_placeholder | escape }}"
              data-footer-diagnosis-website
              required
            >
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field footer-diagnosis__field--full">
            <label class="footer-diagnosis__label" for="{{ form_id }}-goals">
              {{ section_settings.goals_label }}
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="{{ form_id }}-goals"
              name="contact[Goals or Challenges]"
              class="footer-diagnosis__input footer-diagnosis__input--textarea"
              rows="4"
              placeholder="{{ section_settings.goals_placeholder }}"
              required
            >{{- form.body | escape -}}</textarea>
          </div>

          <div class="footer-diagnosis__field footer-diagnosis__field--full">
            <button type="submit" class="footer-diagnosis__submit">
              {{- section_settings.submit_label -}}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      {%- endform -%}
    </footer-diagnosis>
````

## snippets/custom-hero-mobile-reflection.liquid

````liquid
{% doc %}
  Mobile reflection selection extracted from the customized native Hero.
  Decorations load lazily and only render when reflection is enabled.
  @param {object} section - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {boolean} fallback_to_desktop - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} media_1_mobile - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} media_2_mobile - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} media_blurred - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} mobile_widths - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} sizes_mobile - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {number} media_count - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} media_2 - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} media_1 - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} widths - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @param {string} sizes - Hero media selection value from the owning section.
  @example {% render 'custom-hero-mobile-reflection', section: section, fallback_to_desktop: true, media_1_mobile: 'none', media_2_mobile: 'none', media_blurred: '', mobile_widths: '', sizes_mobile: '100vw', media_count: 0, media_1: 'none', media_2: 'none', widths: '', sizes: '100vw' %}
{% enddoc %}

  {%- comment -%}
    On mobile we need to check:
    1. If the media should be stacked. If it is,we check for the second (bottom) image first, then for the first (top) image.
    2. If custom mobile setting is active and has media (show desktop media otherwise).
  {%- endcomment -%}
  {% if section.settings.stack_media_on_mobile == false %}
    {% if section.settings.custom_mobile_media == true and fallback_to_desktop == false %}
      {% if media_1_mobile == 'image' %}
        {{ section.settings.image_1_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_1_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_1_mobile.height,
            alt: '',
            class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
            sizes: sizes_mobile
          }}
      {% endif %}
      {% if media_2_mobile == 'image' %}
        {{ section.settings.image_2_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_2_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_2_mobile.height,
            alt: '',
            class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
            sizes: sizes_mobile
          }}
      {% endif %}
    {% elsif fallback_to_desktop %}
      {{ media_blurred }}
    {% endif %}
  {% elsif section.settings.stack_media_on_mobile == true %}
    {% if section.settings.custom_mobile_media == true and fallback_to_desktop == false %}
      {% if media_2_mobile == 'image' %}
        {{ section.settings.image_2_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_2_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_2_mobile.height,
            alt: '',
            class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
            sizes: sizes_mobile
        }}
      {% elsif media_1_mobile == 'image' %}
        {{ section.settings.image_1_mobile
          | image_url: width: 1600
          | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_1_mobile.width,
            widths: mobile_widths,
            height: section.settings.image_1_mobile.height,
            alt: '',
            class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
            sizes: sizes_mobile
          }}
      {% endif %}
    {% elsif fallback_to_desktop %}
      {% if media_count > 0 %}
        {% if media_2 == 'image' %}
          {{ section.settings.image_2
            | image_url: width: 1600
            | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_2.width,
              widths: widths,
              height: section.settings.image_2.height,
              alt: '',
              class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
              sizes: sizes
            }}
        {% elsif media_1 == 'image' %}
          {{ section.settings.image_1
            | image_url: width: 1600
            | image_tag: width: section.settings.image_1.width,
              widths: widths,
              height: section.settings.image_1.height,
              alt: '',
              class: 'hero__media',
            loading: 'lazy',
            decoding: 'async',
              sizes: sizes
            }}
        {% endif %}
        {% if media_count == 0 %}
          {{ 'hero-apparel-1' | placeholder_svg_tag: 'hero__media' }}
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    {% endif %}
  {% endif %}
````

````liquid
{% doc %}
````
