## snippets/custom-section-fonts.liquid

````liquid
{%- doc -%}
  Compatibility for a saved section font outside the globally loaded theme families.
  Theme families already include weights 300–700 in theme-styles-variables; do not
  redeclare them per section. Keep an existing merchant's other family usable.
  @param {font} font - Existing section font-picker value.
  @example {% render 'custom-section-fonts', font: section.settings.font %}
{%- enddoc -%}
{%- liquid
  assign global_family = false
  if font.family == settings.type_body_font.family or font.family == settings.type_heading_font.family or font.family == settings.type_subheading_font.family or font.family == settings.type_accent_font.family
    assign global_family = true
  endif
  if font.style != 'normal'
    assign global_family = false
  endif
-%}
{%- unless global_family or font == blank -%}
  {% style %}
    {%- assign weights = '400,500,600' | split: ',' -%}
    {%- for weight in weights limit: 3 -%}
      {%- assign face = font | font_modify: 'weight', weight -%}
      {%- if face -%}{{ face | font_face: font_display: 'swap' }}{%- endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
  {% endstyle %}
{%- endunless -%}
````

## snippets/growth-hero.liquid

````liquid
{% doc %}
  Renders the homepage growth layout using the Hero section's existing media and blocks.
  @param {section} section - Hero section, including responsive media and layout settings.
  @param {string} children - Captured merchant-managed Hero blocks.
  @param {string} media - Captured responsive Hero media markup.
  @param {number} media_count - Number of selected desktop media slots.
  @param {number} media_count_mobile - Number of selected mobile media slots.
  @example
  {% render 'growth-hero', section: section, children: hero_blocks, media: media, media_count: media_count, media_count_mobile: media_count_mobile %}
{% enddoc %}

{% liquid
  # Growth layout is an existing customization of the native Hero; preserve its contract.
  assign poster_loading = 'lazy'
  assign poster_priority = 'auto'
  if section.index <= 2
    assign poster_loading = 'eager'
    assign poster_priority = 'high'
  endif
  assign color_id = 'growth-hero-' | append: section.id
  assign poster_image = section.settings.video_1.preview_image | default: section.settings.video_2.preview_image
  assign has_video = false
  if section.settings.media_type_1 == 'video' and section.settings.video_1 != blank
    assign has_video = true
  endif
  if section.settings.media_type_2 == 'video' and section.settings.video_2 != blank
    assign has_video = true
  endif
  if section.settings.custom_mobile_media
    if section.settings.media_type_1_mobile == 'video' and section.settings.video_1_mobile != blank
      assign has_video = true
    endif
    if section.settings.media_type_2_mobile == 'video' and section.settings.video_2_mobile != blank
      assign has_video = true
    endif
  endif
%}
{% render 'contrast-override', background_color: section.settings.background_color, section_id: color_id %}
{% if has_video %}
  <script src="{{ 'growth-hero.js' | asset_url }}" type="module" fetchpriority="low"></script>
{% endif %}

<growth-hero-component
  class="growth-hero color-custom-{{ color_id }}{% if section.settings.stack_media_on_mobile %} hero--stack-mobile{% endif %}"
  style="
    --growth-hero-gap: {{ section.settings.gap }}px;
    {% case section.settings.section_height %}
      {% when 'large' %}--growth-hero-height: min(51.042cqw, 735px);
      {% when 'custom' %}--growth-hero-height: {{ section.settings.section_height_custom }}svh;
      {% when 'full-screen' %}--growth-hero-height: 100svh;
      {% when 'auto' %}--growth-hero-height: 0px;
      {% else %}--growth-hero-height: var(--section-height-{{ section.settings.section_height }});
    {% endcase %}
  "
>
  {% if has_video %}
    <div class="growth-hero__poster" aria-hidden="true">
      {% if poster_image != blank %}
        {% render 'background-media', background_media: 'image', background_image: poster_image, background_image_position: 'cover', section: section %}
      {% else %}
        <img src="{{ 'growth-hero-background.png' | asset_url }}" width="1440" height="735" alt="" decoding="async" loading="{{ poster_loading }}" fetchpriority="{{ poster_priority }}">
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}
  <div
    id="GrowthHeroMedia-{{ section.id }}"
    ref="media"
    class="growth-hero__media hero__media-grid"
    style="--hero-media-count: {{ media_count | at_least: 1 }}; --hero-media-count-mobile: {{ media_count_mobile | at_least: 1 }};"
    {% unless has_video %}aria-hidden="true"{% endunless %}
  >
    {{ media }}
  </div>
  {% if section.settings.toggle_overlay %}
    {% render 'overlay', settings: section.settings, layer: '1' %}
  {% endif %}
  <div class="growth-hero__layout">
    <div
      class="growth-hero__content layout-panel-flex layout-panel-flex--{{ section.settings.content_direction }}{% if section.settings.vertical_on_mobile %} mobile-column{% endif %}"
      style="{% render 'layout-panel-style', settings: section.settings %}{% render 'spacing-style', settings: section.settings %}"
    >
      {{ children }}
    </div>
  </div>
  {% if has_video %}
    <button
      ref="toggle"
      type="button"
      class="growth-hero__toggle"
      on:click="/togglePlayback"
      aria-controls="GrowthHeroMedia-{{ section.id }}"
      data-play-label="{{ 'accessibility.play_video' | t | escape }}"
      data-pause-label="{{ 'accessibility.pause_video' | t | escape }}"
      aria-label="{{ 'accessibility.play_video' | t | escape }}"
      hidden
    >
      <span ref="icon" aria-hidden="true">▶</span>
    </button>
  {% endif %}
</growth-hero-component>

{% stylesheet %}
  .growth-hero {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: clip;
    container-type: inline-size;
    background-color: var(--color-background);
  }
  .growth-hero__media { inset: 0; z-index: 0; }
  .growth-hero__media :is(img, video).hero__media { inline-size: 105.833%; block-size: 105.714%; inset-inline-start: -2.917%; object-position: center; }
  .growth-hero__poster { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; }
  .growth-hero__poster > img { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  .growth-hero__layout {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    inline-size: 100%;
    max-inline-size: 1440px;

    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  .growth-hero__content {
    min-inline-size: 0;
    padding-block: calc(min(11.25cqw, 162px) + var(--padding-block-start, 0px)) calc(min(7.847cqw, 113px) + var(--padding-block-end, 0px));
    padding-inline: 4.931%;
    gap: var(--growth-hero-gap);
  }
  .growth-hero__content > .group-block { max-inline-size: min(48.056cqw, 692px); }
  .growth-hero__content .text-block { min-inline-size: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .growth-hero__content .text-block:has(h1) { max-inline-size: 692px; }
  .growth-hero__content .text-block:has(h1) h1 { font-size: inherit; }
  .growth-hero__content .text-block:has(p) { max-inline-size: min(41.181cqw, 593px); }
  .growth-hero__content > :is(.button, .button-custom, .button-secondary) {
    min-block-size: 62px;
    max-inline-size: 100%;
    padding-block: 13px;
    padding-inline: 33px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .growth-hero__toggle {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;

  .growth-hero__toggle[hidden] { display: none; }
  .growth-hero__media video { pointer-events: auto; }
  .growth-hero[data-enhanced] .growth-hero__media video { pointer-events: none; }
  .growth-hero[data-enhanced] .growth-hero__media video:not([data-playing]) { opacity: 0; }
  @media screen and (min-width: 750px) and (max-width: 1100px) {
    .growth-hero__content { padding-block-start: 90px; padding-block-end: 80px; }
    .growth-hero__content > .group-block { max-inline-size: 58%; }
    .growth-hero__content .text-block:has(h1) { font-size: min(var(--font-size), 2.5rem); }

  }
  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
    .growth-hero__layout { min-block-size: 660px; }

    .growth-hero__content {
      padding: 56px 24px 250px;

      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(var(--color-background-rgb) / 0.94) 0%, rgb(var(--color-background-rgb) / 0.88) 62%, rgb(var(--color-background-rgb) / 0) 100%);
    }
    .growth-hero__content > .group-block { max-inline-size: 100%; }
    .growth-hero__content .text-block:has(h1) { font-size: min(var(--font-size), 2rem); }

  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## snippets/scroll-reveal-styles.liquid

````liquid
{%- doc -%}
  Shared scroll-reveal styles.

  Elements marked `[data-reveal]` inside a `[data-reveal-scope]` root fade and
  translate once from hidden below (`before`) to visible (`in`). Revealed
  elements stay visible. Hidden styles apply once the script adds `reveal-ready`, so content stays visible
  when JavaScript is unavailable.

  @example
  {% render 'scroll-reveal-styles' %}
{%- enddoc -%}

{% stylesheet %}
  scroll-reveal-component:not(.section) { display: block; }

  .reveal-ready [data-reveal] {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(32px);
    transition:
      opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-cubic),
      transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-cubic);
    transition-delay: min(calc(var(--reveal-index, 0) * 90ms), 540ms);
  }

  .reveal-ready [data-reveal][data-state='in'] {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .reveal-ready [data-reveal] {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
      transition: none;
    }
  }
{% endstylesheet %}
````

## tests/custom-section-lifecycle.test.cjs

````javascript
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const path = require('node:path');

function environment(file, { reduced = false, editor = false, loadGlobe } = {}) {
  const observers = [];
  const frames = new Map();
  const log = [];
  const definitions = new Map();
  let frameId = 0;
  class Motion extends EventTarget { matches = reduced; }
  const motion = new Motion();
  class Element extends EventTarget {
    attrs = new Map();
    dataset = {};
    children = [];
    refs = {};
    isConnected = true;
    classList = { values: new Set(), add: (x) => this.classList.values.add(x), remove: (x) => this.classList.values.delete(x), contains: (x) => this.classList.values.has(x) };
    hasAttribute(x) { return this.attrs.has(x); }
    setAttribute(x, y) { this.attrs.set(x, y); }
    removeAttribute(x) { this.attrs.delete(x); }
    querySelectorAll() { return this.children; }
    connectedCallback() {}
    updatedCallback() {}
    disconnectedCallback() {}
  }
  class Observer {
    targets = new Set();
    disconnected = false;
    constructor(callback) { this.callback = callback; observers.push(this); }
    observe(target) { this.targets.add(target); }
    unobserve(target) { this.targets.delete(target); }
    disconnect() { this.targets.clear(); this.disconnected = true; }
    enter(target, visible = true) { this.callback([{ target, isIntersecting: visible }]); }
  }
  const win = new EventTarget();
  Object.assign(win, { innerHeight: 800, Shopify: { designMode: editor } });
  const doc = new EventTarget();
  doc.hidden = false;
  const context = {
    Component: Element, HTMLElement: Element, HTMLInputElement: Element, Element,
    Event, AbortController, queueMicrotask, console, window: win, document: doc,
    innerHeight: 800, devicePixelRatio: 1, matchMedia: () => motion,
    IntersectionObserver: Observer, ResizeObserver: Observer,
    requestAnimationFrame(callback) { frames.set(++frameId, callback); return frameId; },
    cancelAnimationFrame(id) { frames.delete(id); },
    customElements: { get: (name) => definitions.get(name), define: (name, value) => definitions.set(name, value) },
    loadGlobe,
  };
  let source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'assets', file), 'utf8').replace(/^import .*;\n/, '');
  source = source.replace("import('./cobe.js')", 'loadGlobe()');
  vm.runInNewContext(source, context);
  return { create: () => new [...definitions.values()][0](), Element, observers, motion, frames, win, doc, log };
}

function revealTarget(env, top) {
  const target = new env.Element();
  target.dataset = new Proxy({}, { set(object, key, value) { env.log.push('write'); object[key] = value; return true; } });
  target.getBoundingClientRect = () => { env.log.push('read'); return { top, bottom: top + 100 }; };
  target.style = { setProperty() { env.log.push('write'); } };
  return target;
}

test('reveal batches geometry reads, isolates instances, and cleans observers on re-render/removal', () => {
  const env = environment('scroll-reveal.js');
  const first = env.create(); first.setAttribute('data-reveal-scope', '');
  first.children = [revealTarget(env, 100), revealTarget(env, 1000)];
  first.connectedCallback();
  assert.deepEqual(env.log.slice(0, 2), ['read', 'read']);
  assert.equal(first.children[0].dataset.state, 'in');
  assert.equal(first.children[1].dataset.state, 'before');
  const second = env.create(); second.setAttribute('data-reveal-scope', '');
  second.children = [revealTarget(env, 1200)]; second.connectedCallback();
  env.observers[0].enter(first.children[1]);
  assert.equal(second.children[0].dataset.state, 'before');
  first.updatedCallback();
  assert.equal(env.observers[0].disconnected, true);
  first.disconnectedCallback(); second.disconnectedCallback();
  assert(env.observers.every((observer) => observer.disconnected));
  assert.equal(first.classList.contains('reveal-ready'), false);
});

test('reveal immediately restores visibility when reduced motion changes, and skips editor effects', () => {
  const env = environment('scroll-reveal.js');
  const el = env.create(); el.setAttribute('data-reveal-scope', '');
  el.children = [revealTarget(env, 1200)]; el.connectedCallback();
  env.motion.matches = true; env.motion.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  assert.equal(el.classList.contains('reveal-ready'), false);
  assert(env.observers.every((o) => o.disconnected));
  el.disconnectedCallback();
  const editor = environment('scroll-reveal.js', { editor: true });
  const edited = editor.create(); edited.setAttribute('data-reveal-scope', '');
  edited.children = [revealTarget(editor, 1200)]; edited.connectedCallback();
  assert.equal(editor.observers.length, 0);
  edited.disconnectedCallback();
});

test('disabled reveal scope does not create observers or change visible content', () => {
  const env = environment('scroll-reveal.js');
  const el = env.create(); el.children = [revealTarget(env, 1200)];
  el.connectedCallback();
  assert.equal(env.observers.length, 0);
  assert.equal(el.classList.contains('reveal-ready'), false);
  el.disconnectedCallback();
});

test('footer prevents duplicate native submissions, restores after pageshow, and cancels work on removal', async () => {
  const env = environment('footer-diagnosis.js');
  const footer = env.create();
  const form = new env.Element(); const website = new env.Element(); const button = new env.Element();
  website.value = 'example.com'; form.checkValidity = () => true;
  form.querySelector = (selector) => selector.includes('website') ? website : button;
  footer.querySelector = () => form;
  footer.connectedCallback();
  website.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur'));
  assert.equal(website.value, 'https://example.com');
  form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { cancelable: true })); await Promise.resolve();
  assert.equal(button.attrs.get('aria-disabled'), 'true');
  const duplicate = new Event('submit', { cancelable: true }); form.dispatchEvent(duplicate);
  assert.equal(duplicate.defaultPrevented, true);
  env.win.dispatchEvent(new Event('pageshow'));
  assert.equal(button.attrs.has('aria-disabled'), false);
  form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { cancelable: true })); footer.disconnectedCallback();
  await Promise.resolve();
  assert.equal(button.attrs.has('aria-disabled'), false);
  footer.connectedCallback(); footer.disconnectedCallback();
});

test('globe skips WebGL entirely with reduced motion and does not initialize after leaving viewport during import', async () => {
  let imports = 0; let renders = 0; let resolveImport;
  const env = environment('services-globe.js', { reduced: true, loadGlobe: () => { imports++; return new Promise((resolve) => { resolveImport = resolve; }); } });
  const globe = env.create();
  const canvas = new env.Element(); const host = new env.Element(); host.clientWidth = 400;
  canvas.parentElement = host;
  canvas.getContext = () => ({ isContextLost: () => false, getError: () => 0, NO_ERROR: 0 });
  globe.refs = { canvas, host, fallback: new env.Element() };
  globe.connectedCallback(); env.observers[0].enter(globe);
  assert.equal(imports, 0);
  env.motion.matches = false; env.motion.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  assert.equal(imports, 1);
  env.observers[0].enter(globe, false);
  resolveImport({ default: () => { renders++; return { update() {}, destroy() {} }; } });
  await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve();
  assert.equal(renders, 0);
  globe.disconnectedCallback();
  assert.equal(env.frames.size, 0);
  assert(env.observers.every((o) => o.disconnected));
});
````
